FifteenMinutesOfFame.name: 15 Minutes of Fame
FifteenMinutesOfFame.def: Someone becomes famous for a short amount of time.

AbortionFalloutDrama.name: Abortion Fallout Drama
AbortionFalloutDrama.def: Plotline focusing on how getting an abortion affects the character and her relationships.

AbuseMistake.name: Abuse Mistake
AbuseMistake.def: Something innocent is mistaken for abuse or vice-versa.

AccidentalAthlete.name: Accidental Athlete
AccidentalAthlete.def: Someone discovers their athletic ability while doing something else.

AccidentalHero.name: Accidental Hero
AccidentalHero.def: A person performs a heroic action by complete accident.

AchillesInHisTent.name: Achilles in His Tent
AchillesInHisTent.def: A powerful team member quits, but returns to save the day just as the team needs their specific talents.

ActionHeroBabysitter.name: Action-Hero Babysitter
ActionHeroBabysitter.def: An Action Hero put in a position of responsibility for children. Typically Played for Laughs .

AdaptationalGoalChange.name: Adaptational Goal Change
AdaptationalGoalChange.def: A character has a plan, but it's a different plan in the adaptation to what it was in the source material.

AdventureRebuff.name: Adventure Rebuff
AdventureRebuff.def: One character tries to keep another character out of trouble by forbidding them to go on missions with him, which never works.

AdventuresInTheBible.name: Adventures in the Bible
AdventuresInTheBible.def: Time travel to events from religion or mythology.

AgainstTheGrain.name: Against the Grain
AgainstTheGrain.def: A character doesn't fulfil their expected role.

AllForNothing.name: All for Nothing
AllForNothing.def: A story's buildup gets its payoff. A later event renders it meaningless.

AllThatGlitters.name: All That Glitters
AllThatGlitters.def: Expected treasure turns out to be worthless.

AllUpToYou.name: All Up to You
AllUpToYou.def: An Unlikely Hero is the only one who can solve the problem.

AllYourBaseAreBelongToUs.name: All Your Base Are Belong to Us
AllYourBaseAreBelongToUs.def: The villains take over the hero's lair.

AlienInvasion.name: Alien Invasion
AlienInvasion.def: Aliens plan to invade a planet.

AllegoryAdventure.name: Allegory Adventure
AllegoryAdventure.def: A creative work in which the characters, plot, or both parallel those in another creative work.

AlternateUniverse.name: Alternate Universe
AlternateUniverse.def: Other worlds similar to ours, but with key differences.

AmateurFilmMakingPlot.name: Amateur Film-Making Plot
AmateurFilmMakingPlot.def: Characters try to create a low budget film.

AmericaSavesTheDay.name: America Saves the Day
AmericaSavesTheDay.def: A world-wide problem is solved by the United States.

AmnesiaDanger.name: Amnesia Danger
AmnesiaDanger.def: A character would be able to deal with this easily if they had their memories. Unfortunately, they don't.

AndNowYouMustMarryMe.name: And Now You Must Marry Me
AndNowYouMustMarryMe.def: The villain tries to force a protagonist to marry them.

AnimalAthleteLoophole.name: Animal Athlete Loophole
AnimalAthleteLoophole.def: An animal plays sports since no rule bars it.

AnimalTesting.name: Animal Testing
AnimalTesting.def: The controversial act of testing medicine on animals.

AnnoyingPatient.name: Annoying Patient
AnnoyingPatient.def: A sick character is really annoying to their caretaker.

AntagonistInMourning.name: Antagonist in Mourning
AntagonistInMourning.def: The villain feels sorry for the hero's death.

AnticlimacticParent.name: Anti-Climactic Parent
AnticlimacticParent.def: A variant of The Reveal in which a character spends the episode getting the cast in an uproar about a parental visit.

AntiSchoolUniformsPlot.name: Anti-School Uniforms Plot
AntiSchoolUniformsPlot.def: A group of students protest a newly installed rule requiring school uniforms.

ApopheniaPlot.name: Apophenia Plot
ApopheniaPlot.def: A character misinteprets a series of events and thinks they see a conspiracy where none exists.

AppeaseTheVolcanoGod.name: Appease the Volcano God
AppeaseTheVolcanoGod.def: A group try to throw a character into a volcano to appease the volcano god.

AprilFoolsPlot.name: April Fools' Plot
AprilFoolsPlot.def: An episode set on April Fools' Day.

AsinineAlternateActivity.name: Asinine Alternate Activity
AsinineAlternateActivity.def: A character isn't allowed to do something they want, with a boring alternative offered instead.

AssimilationPlot.name: Assimilation Plot
AssimilationPlot.def: A villain attempts to eliminate all differences between people.

AttackOfTheTownFestival.name: Attack of the Town Festival
AttackOfTheTownFestival.def: A town holding a festival is under attack.

AwkwardFirstSleepover.name: Awkward First Sleepover
AwkwardFirstSleepover.def: A socially awkward child, teen or adult attends their first sleepover.

AxesAtSchool.name: Axes at School
AxesAtSchool.def: Someone brings a weapon to class.

TheBGrade.name: The B Grade
TheBGrade.def: Someone gets upset over getting a grade that is slightly less than perfect.

BachelorAuction.name: Bachelor Auction
BachelorAuction.def: A bunch of male characters get together for a "date auction", usually for charity. Occasionally gender flipped .

BackToSchool.name: Back to School
BackToSchool.def: An adult character returns to school.

BadHairDay.name: Bad Hair Day
BadHairDay.def: A character suffers from a bad hair day, most likely on a day they absolutely need to look their best, and try various methods to get rid of the messy hair or hide it somehow.

BadLuckCharm.name: Bad Luck Charm
BadLuckCharm.def: A character finds an item that is deemed to give bad luck.

BadSamaritan.name: Bad Samaritan
BadSamaritan.def: Someone takes in the hero and seems (at first) to be helping, but they have ulterior motives.

BadSanta.name: Bad Santa
BadSanta.def: Santa Claus has either gone bad or has a villainous impostor or rival.

BadassInDistress.name: Badass in Distress
BadassInDistress.def: An Action Hero finds themself in the role of a Damsel in Distress / Distressed Dude .

BandEpisode.name: Band Episode
BandEpisode.def: The characters form a band or a musical group.

TheBardOnBoard.name: The Bard on Board
TheBardOnBoard.def: A work based on the plot of a Shakespeare play.

BatheHerAndBringHerToMe.name: Bathe Her and Bring Her to Me
BatheHerAndBringHerToMe.def: The villain has the damsel cleaned up before... well, you know.

BatmanInMyBasement.name: Batman in My Basement
BatmanInMyBasement.def: A character hides out in someone's home. One resident has to keep the others from finding out.

BeCarefulWhatYouWishFor.name: Be Careful What You Wish For
BeCarefulWhatYouWishFor.def: Someone makes a wish and finds out the hard way that their desire has its downsides.

BeYourself.name: Be Yourself
BeYourself.def: Someone tries to change who they are to accomplish their goal or so that people will like them better. They learn in the end that they're fine just the way they are.

BeautyContest.name: Beauty Contest
BeautyContest.def: A contest in which people are judged by their appearance and social grace.

BecomingTheCostume.name: Becoming the Costume
BecomingTheCostume.def: People are turned into whatever they're dressed to be.

BecomingTheMask.name: Becoming the Mask
BecomingTheMask.def: A character becomes like the person they pretend to be.

BenchedHero.name: Benched Hero
BenchedHero.def: A hero is temporarily removed to keep things interesting.

BenevolentConspiracy.name: Benevolent Conspiracy
BenevolentConspiracy.def: A secret plan is happening, but for noble reasons.

BetterIfNotBornPlot.name: "Better If Not Born" Plot
BetterIfNotBornPlot.def: Someone is shown what the world would be like if they never existed, and everyone's lives are enriched because of it.

BigLippedAlligatorMoment.name: Big-Lipped Alligator Moment
BigLippedAlligatorMoment.def: A bizarre scene that comes out of nowhere, has no significance on the plot, and is never mentioned again after it ends.

BirthdayPartyGoesWrong.name: Birthday Party Goes Wrong
BirthdayPartyGoesWrong.def: A birthday party is getting ruined: the cake is burnt or dropped, the presents are horrible, the guests are annoying... and the birthday kid ends up unhappy on their special day. Unless his family and friends try to make it up for them and cheer them up.

BizarroEpisode.name: Bizarro Episode
BizarroEpisode.def: An episode that is weirder than the rest of the series.

BlackLikeMe.name: Black Like Me
BlackLikeMe.def: A character disguises themself as a member of a different social group and discovers how they are treated differently.

BloodTransfusionPlot.name: Blood Transfusion Plot
BloodTransfusionPlot.def: A character needs a blood transfusion, but there are complications.

BodyCountCompetition.name: Body-Count Competition
BodyCountCompetition.def: Characters compete to see who kills the most Mooks .

BodyHorror.name: Body Horror
BodyHorror.def: A plot involving grotesque body structures.

BodySnatcher.name: Body Snatcher
BodySnatcher.def: A character's body is taken over by some foreign intelligence.

BodySurf.name: Body Surf
BodySurf.def: A character possesses multiple people in succession.

BottleEpisode.name: Bottle Episode
BottleEpisode.def: An episode that saves budget money by going easy on the number of characters, props, locations, etc. that can be used.

Brainwashed.name: Brainwashed
Brainwashed.def: Someone has used Applied Phlebotinum to control the mind of another character.

BrainwashedAndCrazy.name: Brainwashed and Crazy
BrainwashedAndCrazy.def: A brainwashed character is sent to hurt or kill their friends.

BraveTheRidePlot.name: "Brave the Ride" Plot
BraveTheRidePlot.def: An episode set at an amusement park where a character must get over their fear of a ride, usually a roller coaster.

TheBreakfastPlot.name: The Breakfast Plot
TheBreakfastPlot.def: A group of characters gets stuck together (in what may or may not be detention) and end up bonding.

BreakingOutTheBoss.name: Breaking Out the Boss
BreakingOutTheBoss.def: Members of a gang of criminals orchestrate a plan to free their incarcerated leader from prison.

BreakoutMookCharacter.name: Breakout Mook Character
BreakoutMookCharacter.def: A spin-off centering on a Mascot Mook .

TheBrideWithAPast.name: The Bride with a Past
TheBrideWithAPast.def: A bride is discovered to have been a stripper (or something similar) before becoming engaged.

BringHelpBack.name: Bring Help Back
BringHelpBack.def: A group in distress sends one of their own to get help for them.

BringItBackAlive.name: Bring It Back Alive
BringItBackAlive.def: A character must capture a dangerous creature alive.

BringNewsBack.name: Bring News Back
BringNewsBack.def: The characters must get information to the right people.

BrokenMasquerade.name: Broken Masquerade
BrokenMasquerade.def: Someone discovers the truth behind a Masquerade .

BrokenPedestal.name: Broken Pedestal
BrokenPedestal.def: A person who idolized someone they saw as a hero starts hating their hero after discovering them to not truly be the flawless paragon of virtue they thought they were.

BrokenTreasure.name: Broken Treasure
BrokenTreasure.def: A character's most prized possession is broken while they are away, and now the other characters have to fix it or replace it before the character gets back.

BrokenWinLossStreak.name: Broken Win/Loss Streak
BrokenWinLossStreak.def: A streak of consecutive wins or losses is broken.

BroughtDownToBadass.name: Brought Down to Badass
BroughtDownToBadass.def: A super-powered being loses their powers, but is still plenty strong and formidable without powers.

BroughtDownToNormal.name: Brought Down to Normal
BroughtDownToNormal.def: A character with powers loses or is stripped of them, and must cope without them and/or get them back.

BruceWayneHeldHostage.name: Bruce Wayne Held Hostage
BruceWayneHeldHostage.def: A Superhero in their Secret Identity is taken hostage and has to save the day without blowing their cover.

BulkBuyOnly.name: Bulk-Buy Only
BulkBuyOnly.def: Character spends an entire episode trying to get something, only to have to buy massive amounts of it.

BuryMeNotOnTheLonePrairie.name: Bury Me Not on the Lone Prairie
BuryMeNotOnTheLonePrairie.def: Someone has difficulty honoring the last requests of a deceased person.

BusmansHoliday.name: Busman's Holiday
BusmansHoliday.def: A character on vacation ends up having to do what they usually wind up doing.

ButICantBePregnant.name: But I Can't Be Pregnant!
ButICantBePregnant.def: A character turns out to be pregnant, despite this being thought impossible.

CabinFever.name: Cabin Fever
CabinFever.def: Characters go crazy from being cooped up in an isolated area for an extended period with no outside contact.

CainAndAbel.name: Cain and Abel
CainAndAbel.def: Sibling rivalry turns into bitter, murderous hatred.

TheCakeIsALie.name: The Cake Is a Lie
TheCakeIsALie.def: A promised reward turns out to be nothing but a lie.

CameBackWithAVengeance.name: Came Back with a Vengeance
CameBackWithAVengeance.def: A wronged innocent returns under an assumed name in order to take revenge on their former tormentors. Inspired by The Count of Monte Cristo .

CantGetAwayWithNuthin.name: Can't Get Away with Nuthin'
CantGetAwayWithNuthin.def: Do something bad? Even once? You're gonna get it, pal.

CantGetInTroubleForNuthin.name: Can't Get in Trouble for Nuthin'
CantGetInTroubleForNuthin.def: A character wants to get in trouble, but can't.

TheCaper.name: The Caper
TheCaper.def: A group of protagonists organize an elaborate robbery.

CaperRationalization.name: Caper Rationalization
CaperRationalization.def: The group of people doing The Caper have a good reason to steal.

TheCaptivityNarrative.name: The Captivity Narrative
TheCaptivityNarrative.def: A Puritan girl is captured by Natives and has to resist their culture. Discredited and forgotten these days.

CattleDrive.name: Cattle Drive
CattleDrive.def: An old Western plot involving ranchers having to get cattle to market under dangerous conditions.

CaughtInTheBadPartOfTown.name: Caught in the Bad Part of Town
CaughtInTheBadPartOfTown.def: A character finds themselves in an unfamiliar and run down (and often dangerous) neighborhood.

CaughtUpInARobbery.name: Caught Up in a Robbery
CaughtUpInARobbery.def: A plot in which a work's main or supporting characters get wrapped up in a robbery that suddenly and unexpectedly occurs at their location.

CelebrityIsOverrated.name: Celebrity is Overrated
CelebrityIsOverrated.def: Fame isn't all it's cracked up to be.

CelebrityLie.name: Celebrity Lie
CelebrityLie.def: Lying about being close to a celebrity.

CelebrityStar.name: Celebrity Star
CelebrityStar.def: An episode of a show makes the best possible use of its celebrity guest star.

ChainOfDeals.name: Chain of Deals
ChainOfDeals.def: Someone has to make deals with a whole bunch of people in order to get what they want.

TheChainOfHarm.name: The Chain of Harm
TheChainOfHarm.def: A character who was abused unleashes the same kind of abuse on someone else.

ChainedHeat.name: Chained Heat
ChainedHeat.def: Characters become literally attached to each other and must work together in order to reverse it.

ChangingOfTheGuard.name: Changing of the Guard
ChangingOfTheGuard.def: A sequel which features or focuses on different characters from the original work.

CharacterFocus.name: Character Focus
CharacterFocus.def: Focusing on one character's development at a time.

CharityWorkplaceCalendar.name: Charity Workplace Calendar
CharityWorkplaceCalendar.def: Posing for a workplace calendar to raise money.

CharlieAndTheChocolateParody.name: Charlie and the Chocolate Parody
CharlieAndTheChocolateParody.def: A work is a Whole-Plot Reference to Charlie and the Chocolate Factory .

TheChase.name: The Chase
TheChase.def: A plot centered on characters pursuing one another.

ChasedByAngryNatives.name: Chased by Angry Natives
ChasedByAngryNatives.def: A character gets chased by angry native population.

CheerUpEpisode.name: Cheer Up Episode
CheerUpEpisode.def: One character is down in the dumps, and the other characters attempt to make them happier.

ChickenPoxEpisode.name: Chicken Pox Episode
ChickenPoxEpisode.def: A character comes down with chicken pox (or a fantastic equivalent).

ChildhoodMemoryDemolitionTeam.name: Childhood Memory Demolition Team
ChildhoodMemoryDemolitionTeam.def: A construction team that destroys a character's childhood memories when said character grows up.

ChildrenRaiseYou.name: Children Raise You
ChildrenRaiseYou.def: Character Development comes from looking after a kid.

CinderellaPlot.name: Cinderella Plot
CinderellaPlot.def: Plots inspired by or parodying Cinderella .

CityInABottle.name: City in a Bottle
CityInABottle.def: A city that is sealed away from the rest of the world.

ClassReunion.name: Class Reunion
ClassReunion.def: The graduating class of a school meet each other again at the school years later.

CleanUpTheTown.name: Clean Up the Town
CleanUpTheTown.def: A new person comes to a rundown town, intending to reduce crime and make it a better place.

ClearMyName.name: Clear My Name
ClearMyName.def: Someone has to prove they're innocent of the crime they're accused of committing.

ClearTheirName.name: Clear Their Name
ClearTheirName.def: Someone else takes it upon them to prove the innocence of someone wrongly accused of a crime.

ClipShow.name: Clip Show
ClipShow.def: An episode that mostly consists of recycled footage from earlier episodes.

ClosedCircle.name: Closed Circle
ClosedCircle.def: No way to get out. No way to get help. You're on your own.

CoaxThemOutOfTheCloset.name: Coax Them Out of the Closet
CoaxThemOutOfTheCloset.def: A closeted character's peers try to get them to come out.

CodeSilver.name: Code Silver
CodeSilver.def: A gunman takes hostages at a hospital, school, or other important place where the characters work.

ColdEquation.name: Cold Equation
ColdEquation.def: In a survival situation, can killing one to save others be a solution?

TheCollector.name: The Collector
TheCollector.def: People version of Collector of the Strange .

ColorMeBlack.name: Color Me Black
ColorMeBlack.def: A character is turned into a member of another race in order to teach them a lesson about racism.

ComicBooksAreReal.name: Comic Books Are Real
ComicBooksAreReal.def: The characters in the Show Within a Show are actually real within the universe that watches it.

ComingOutStory.name: Coming-Out Story
ComingOutStory.def: A gay or other queer character comes out and reveals their sexual orientation to their friends, family and associates.

CommonNonsenseJury.name: Common Nonsense Jury
CommonNonsenseJury.def: A wrong verdict is passed not because of ill intent, unfair rules, etc. The jury's just plain stupid.

CommunityThreateningConstruction.name: Community-Threatening Construction
CommunityThreateningConstruction.def: A planned construction site motivates residents to defend their home, which is subject for demolition.

CompromisingMemoirs.name: Compromising Memoirs
CompromisingMemoirs.def: A memoir is written that contains details about a person that the person does not wish others to know.

TheCon.name: The Con
TheCon.def: Scams used by criminals to illegally acquire money.

ConcertEpisode.name: Concert Episode
ConcertEpisode.def: Characters see a (usually rock) concert together.

ConsolationWorldRecord.name: Consolation World Record
ConsolationWorldRecord.def: Someone fails to break a record and gain recognition for it, but in doing so ends up unintentionally breaking a world record anyway.

TheConspiracy.name: The Conspiracy
TheConspiracy.def: A secret plot from a powerful figure or group is happening and the protagonists investigate it.

ContagiousPowers.name: Contagious Powers
ContagiousPowers.def: Side characters gain superpowers so they can fight alongside The Hero .

ContaminationSituation.name: Contamination Situation
ContaminationSituation.def: Characters are exposed to a potentially deadly pathogen that infects them.

ContractOnTheHitman.name: Contract on the Hitman
ContractOnTheHitman.def: An assassin is marked for death by the very people for whom they work.

TheConvenientStoreNextDoor.name: The Convenient Store Next Door
TheConvenientStoreNextDoor.def: A store is right next door to the place people want to rob.

CookingDuel.name: Cooking Duel
CookingDuel.def: Two rivals compete over who can make better food.

CooperationGambit.name: Cooperation Gambit
CooperationGambit.def: Two enemies make a deal with each other without ending their conflict.

CorporateConspiracy.name: Corporate Conspiracy
CorporateConspiracy.def: A corporation is conspiring with another group for an evil purpose.

CosmeticCatastrophe.name: Cosmetic Catastrophe
CosmeticCatastrophe.def: A girl experiments with makeup for the first time, with negative consequences.

Costumer.name: Costumer
Costumer.def: An alternative reality episode that's an excuse to put the characters in period costume.

CouldHaveAvoidedThisPlot.name: "Could Have Avoided This!" Plot
CouldHaveAvoidedThisPlot.def: After the conflict is resolved, the characters point out that the problem wouldn't have happened in the first place if they had gone with another solution or explained things better to each other.

CouldntFindABabysitter.name: Couldn't Find a Babysitter
CouldntFindABabysitter.def: A character uses a lazy, radical ot otherwise inappropriate alternative to a genuine babsitter.

CounterZany.name: Counter Zany
CounterZany.def: A Zany Scheme is countered by an even Zanier Scheme.

CouplesRetreatPlot.name: Couple's Retreat Plot
CouplesRetreatPlot.def: A couple or group of couples go on a vacation/getaway/holiday to enjoy themselves or repair/save their marriage.

CourtroomEpisode.name: Courtroom Episode
CourtroomEpisode.def: An episode revolves around someone being put on trial for their transgressions.

CrapsackWorld.name: Crapsack World
CrapsackWorld.def: The story takes place in a terrible location to live.

CrashCourseLanding.name: Crash Course Landing
CrashCourseLanding.def: A character with no flying experience has to learn how to land a plane safely.

CrashingTheCoronation.name: Crashing the Coronation
CrashingTheCoronation.def: A mission to stop the wrong person from being crowned ruler.

CreditCardPlot.name: Credit Card Plot
CreditCardPlot.def: A character gets a credit card and starts spending it irresponsibly.

CrossingTheDesert.name: Crossing the Desert
CrossingTheDesert.def: The hero must cross a desert.

CrouchingMoronHiddenBadass.name: Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass
CrouchingMoronHiddenBadass.def: An idiot who can become awesome in situations.

CryingWolf.name: Crying Wolf
CryingWolf.def: Pull too many deliberate false alarms and no one will believe you when you're trying to warn about real danger.

CryptidEpisode.name: Cryptid Episode
CryptidEpisode.def: The characters go and search for some kind of mysterious mythical creature.

CuckooNest.name: Cuckoo Nest
CuckooNest.def: A character is convinced they're in an asylum and the events of the work were just hallucinations, making it (sometimes temporarily, sometimes permanently) ambiguous as to what's real.

CulturalPersonalityMakeover.name: Cultural Personality Makeover
CulturalPersonalityMakeover.def: A character discovers something: a photo, a family record, etc., that reveals some long-lost ancestor or unknown relative belonged to some particular unusual culture.

CuttingTheKnot.name: Cutting the Knot
CuttingTheKnot.def: Solving or bypassing a puzzle with brute force.

DangerWithADeadline.name: Danger with a Deadline
DangerWithADeadline.def: An enemy or obstacle is extremely dangerous, but only for a finite period of time. The plot comes from surviving or avoiding this danger.

DangerousDeviceDisposalDebacle.name: Dangerous Device Disposal Debacle
DangerousDeviceDisposalDebacle.def: Because someone didn't dispose of a Plot Device correctly, it can be freely utilized again for more plot.

DatePeepers.name: Date Peepers
DatePeepers.def: Two people go on a date and are spied on by people they know.

DayInTheLife.name: Day in the Life
DayInTheLife.def: An episode that follows the characters around on their normal routine.

ADayInTheLimelight.name: A Day in the Limelight
ADayInTheLimelight.def: A minor character is given focus for the current episode.

TheDayOfReckoning.name: The Day of Reckoning
TheDayOfReckoning.def: The day when an Evil Overlord is destined to win.

DeadAlternateCounterpart.name: Dead Alternate Counterpart
DeadAlternateCounterpart.def: Character visits an alternate reality where their counterpart has died.

DeadPetSketch.name: Dead Pet Sketch
DeadPetSketch.def: Someone has to take care of someone else's pet while the someone else is away. The pet ends up dying.

ADeadlyAffair.name: A Deadly Affair
ADeadlyAffair.def: An extramarital affair that leads to murder.

DeadlyGame.name: Deadly Game
DeadlyGame.def: When the consequences of losing the game is death.

DeadlyGraduation.name: Deadly Graduation
DeadlyGraduation.def: A character in an evil training program must battle their friend to the death as a final test.

DeadlyRoadTrip.name: Deadly Road Trip
DeadlyRoadTrip.def: Ending up in peril while on vacation.

DeadlyUpgrade.name: Deadly Upgrade
DeadlyUpgrade.def: Character gets an enormous power boost, at the eventual cost of his/her life.

DealWithTheDevil.name: Deal with the Devil
DealWithTheDevil.def: A crooked bargain with an evil person or entity for something one wants, with a bad price attached.

DeathInTheClouds.name: Death in the Clouds
DeathInTheClouds.def: A murder happens on an airplane.

DeathIsASadThing.name: Death Is a Sad Thing
DeathIsASadThing.def: Children learn about death for the first time and are saddened by it.

DeathTakesAHoliday.name: Death Takes a Holiday
DeathTakesAHoliday.def: For some reason, The Grim Reaper stops making people die.

DeclarationOfPersonalIndependence.name: Declaration of Personal Independence
DeclarationOfPersonalIndependence.def: Someone attempts to strike out on their own against their guardians' wishes.

DefeatingTheCheatingOpponent.name: Defeating the Cheating Opponent
DefeatingTheCheatingOpponent.def: The protagonist must beat their opponent fairly after the opponent has been caught cheating.

DefectorFromCommieLand.name: Defector from Commie Land
DefectorFromCommieLand.def: A character is in need of escape from a land where a dictatorial regime is ruling.

DelayedFamilyAcceptance.name: Delayed Family Acceptance
DelayedFamilyAcceptance.def: It's difficult for a character's family member(s) to come to terms with a revelation about that character.

Depower.name: De-power
Depower.def: A superpowered character loses their powers.

DescentIntoAddiction.name: Descent into Addiction
DescentIntoAddiction.def: A character gets involved with drugs or some other substance or experience and descends into addiction.

DesertedIsland.name: Deserted Island
DesertedIsland.def: A small island that's completely uninhabited.

DespiteThePlan.name: Despite the Plan
DespiteThePlan.def: The plan goes horribly wrong, but the heroes achieve their goal anyway.

DestructiveSaviour.name: Destructive Saviour
DestructiveSaviour.def: When a hero causes massive destruction in the course of trying to save a place from a bad guy.

DeusExitMachina.name: Deus Exit Machina
DeusExitMachina.def: The plot is prolonged by phasing out the most powerful character for a bit.

DieHardOnAnX.name: "Die Hard" on an X
DieHardOnAnX.def: Bad guys have taken over a place and taken everyone hostage. The hero is in the place, and must save the day by kicking the bad guys' asses.

DiggingToChina.name: Digging to China
DiggingToChina.def: Someone tries to go to China by digging deep enough into the Earth.

DigitalPiracyIsEvil.name: Digital Piracy Is Evil
DigitalPiracyIsEvil.def: A work makes it clear that they are against digital piracy.

DinnerWithTheBoss.name: Dinner with the Boss
DinnerWithTheBoss.def: A character's boss comes to their home for dinner.

DisabilityAsAnExcuseForJerkassery.name: Disability as an Excuse for Jerkassery
DisabilityAsAnExcuseForJerkassery.def: A disabled person uses the excuse that being disabled means they can get away with being an asshole.

DivideAndConquer.name: Divide and Conquer
DivideAndConquer.def: When a villain gets his enemies fighting each other instead of him.

DividedWeFall.name: Divided We Fall
DividedWeFall.def: Dissension between the heroes gets in the way stopping the villain.

DoctorInfectedByPatient.name: Doctor Infected by Patient
DoctorInfectedByPatient.def: A doctor treating a sick patient catches what the patient has.

DocumentaryEpisode.name: Documentary Episode
DocumentaryEpisode.def: A journalist makes a documentary about the characters and their occupation.

ADogAteMyHomework.name: A Dog Ate My Homework
ADogAteMyHomework.def: A child who has failed to hand in their homework tells their teacher that a dog chewed it up.

TheDogBitesBack.name: The Dog Bites Back
TheDogBitesBack.def: An abused character finally has enough and enacts retribution on their tormentor(s).

DontCelebrateJustYet.name: Don't Celebrate Just Yet
DontCelebrateJustYet.def: The heroes defeat a villain but realize they still have to take care of something else that's occurring.

DontGoInTheWoods.name: Don't Go in the Woods
DontGoInTheWoods.def: Terrible things happen to those who wander into the forest.

DoomedMoralVictor.name: Doomed Moral Victor
DoomedMoralVictor.def: The Hero dies after making his Last Stand .

DoorstopBaby.name: Doorstop Baby
DoorstopBaby.def: A baby left on someone's doorstep gets adopted by whomever lives in the house.

DorkHorseCandidate.name: Dork Horse Candidate
DorkHorseCandidate.def: An underdog character competes against a more popular opponent in an election.

DownTheRabbitHole.name: Down the Rabbit Hole
DownTheRabbitHole.def: A character travels to a bizarro world in a plot structure of Alice in Wonderland .

TheDragonsComeBack.name: The Dragons Come Back
TheDragonsComeBack.def: A (sub)plot revolving around dragons or similar apex predators returning from exile/extinction.

DreadedKidsTable.name: Dreaded Kids' Table
DreadedKidsTable.def: An older child longs to sit with the adults instead of the kids during a family meal.

DriversEdEpisode.name: "Driver's Ed" Episode
DriversEdEpisode.def: A characters learns to drive. Driving Test : A character has to get a driver's license.

DrivingQuestion.name: Driving Question
DrivingQuestion.def: The core element of a plot is a mystery.

DuelToTheDeath.name: Duel to the Death
DuelToTheDeath.def: Two characters, rivals or enemies, go mano a mano , and only one will survive. Usually.

DuelsDecideEverything.name: Duels Decide Everything
DuelsDecideEverything.def: All major conflicts in a work are settled by fair, one-on-one contests.

EarPiercingPlot.name: Ear-Piercing Plot
EarPiercingPlot.def: A young character wants their ears pierced, but is either too scared to do it or is forbidden from doing so by their parents.

EasilyThwartedAlienInvasion.name: Easily Thwarted Alien Invasion
EasilyThwartedAlienInvasion.def: Alien invaders are easily defeated by the humans fighting against the invasion.

EggSitting.name: Egg Sitting
EggSitting.def: Children or teenagers are tasked with looking after eggs, bags of flour, or robots to determine whether they'd make responsible parents.

ElectionDayEpisode.name: Election Day Episode
ElectionDayEpisode.def: Two or more characters run for an elective office.

Elseworld.name: Elseworld
Elseworld.def: A non-canon episode shows a reimagining or "What if" story of the regular continuity.

EmbarrassingRescue.name: Embarrassing Rescue
EmbarrassingRescue.def: A character finds being rescued embarrassing and is angry with the rescuer for helping them.

EmergencyImpersonation.name: Emergency Impersonation
EmergencyImpersonation.def: A character who recently died or has been incapacitated is needed for something, so some other character has to impersonate and fill in for them.

EmergencyRefuelling.name: Emergency Refuelling
EmergencyRefuelling.def: A character is forced to stop their vehicle in order to refuel the gas tank.

EmpireWithADarkSecret.name: Empire with a Dark Secret
EmpireWithADarkSecret.def: A seemingly utopian government turns out to be up to ugly things behind the scenes.

EmptyQuiver.name: Empty Quiver
EmptyQuiver.def: A nuke or other weapon of mass destruction has gone missing, and now the race is on to retrieve it before it falls into the wrong hands.

EndOfAnAge.name: End of an Age
EndOfAnAge.def: The story is set during the end of a particular era in the story's setting, such as the end of the medieval era or the end of the American West.

EnduranceDuel.name: Endurance Duel
EnduranceDuel.def: A showdown to see who can last the longest doing dangerous activities.

EnemyMine.name: Enemy Mine
EnemyMine.def: The hero and the villain reluctantly join forces to defeat a mutual enemy.

EpicRace.name: Epic Race
EpicRace.def: The characters have to proceed from a starting line to a finishing line under some set of rules over the course of an extended period of time.

EpiphanicPrison.name: Epiphanic Prison
EpiphanicPrison.def: A prison someone can't escape from unless they have an epiphany.

EquivalentExchange.name: Equivalent Exchange
EquivalentExchange.def: Giving up something that is equal to what a character desires.

EscapeFromTheCrazyPlace.name: Escape from the Crazy Place
EscapeFromTheCrazyPlace.def: A character is trapped in a horror setting from which they must escape.

EverybodyMustGetStoned.name: Everybody Must Get Stoned
EverybodyMustGetStoned.def: Most or all of the cast gets exposed to some kind of substance that alters their behavior.

EverybodysDeadDave.name: Everybody's Dead, Dave
EverybodysDeadDave.def: A work where all but one character is dead.

EveryoneMeetsEveryone.name: Everyone Meets Everyone
EveryoneMeetsEveryone.def: The first episode shows the main cast coming together.

EverythingButTheGirl.name: Everything but the Girl
EverythingButTheGirl.def: A character can achieve or gain everything they want with the exception of their love interest's affections.

EvilPlan.name: Evil Plan
EvilPlan.def: The villain's plan to do something evil.

EvilTwin.name: Evil Twin
EvilTwin.def: A character has a twin who is evil.

EvilWillFail.name: Evil Will Fail
EvilWillFail.def: The Big Bad loses not just because the heroes were stronger, but because it is inherent to nature that evil will fail.

EvilerThanThou.name: Eviler than Thou
EvilerThanThou.def: A villain proves they're more evil than another villain.

TheEvilsOfFreeWill.name: The Evils of Free Will
TheEvilsOfFreeWill.def: Someone feels that eliminating free will is the only way to achieve utopia.

ExactWords.name: Exact Words
ExactWords.def: It's revealed that what a person said was intended in the exact phrasing and wasn't an idiom or figure of speech.

ExcusePlot.name: Excuse Plot
ExcusePlot.def: A plot that's just an excuse for the action happening.

ExperimentalArcheology.name: Experimental Archeology
ExperimentalArcheology.def: A character tries to prove that an ancient voyage actually occurred by doing it themselves.

ExtremeSportsPlot.name: Extreme Sports Plot
ExtremeSportsPlot.def: A show or movie that has the characters doing extreme sports.

FailedAuditionPlot.name: Failed Audition Plot
FailedAuditionPlot.def: A character fails their audition but learns to move forward and not give up.

FairestOfThemAll.name: Fairest of Them All
FairestOfThemAll.def: A villain who will not stand for anyone being more beautiful than they are.

FairyTaleEpisode.name: Fairy Tale Episode
FairyTaleEpisode.def: The characters reenact a ( parody of a) famous fairy tale.

FakeRelationship.name: Fake Relationship
FakeRelationship.def: Two characters who aren't romantically interested in each other pretend to be a couple.

FakedRipVanWinkle.name: Faked Rip Van Winkle
FakedRipVanWinkle.def: Someone is tricked into thinking that they've woken up in the future.

FalseCrucible.name: False Crucible
FalseCrucible.def: A character is put through a grueling test that turns out to be fake.

FalseUtopia.name: False Utopia
FalseUtopia.def: A "utopian" setting that turns out to be anything but, usually with a horrible secret involved.

FamilialFameFrustrations.name: Familial Fame Frustrations
FamilialFameFrustrations.def: When a family member or members are negatively impacted as a direct result of one or more of their relatives being famous and they have to figure out how to deal with that.

FamilyDisunion.name: Family Disunion
FamilyDisunion.def: Family reunions are a source of major drama.

FantasticVoyagePlot.name: "Fantastic Voyage" Plot
FantasticVoyagePlot.def: Curing a sick person by shrinking and entering their body to confront the germs.

FatalForcedMarch.name: Fatal Forced March
FatalForcedMarch.def: Characters are forced to make a dangerous and likely-deadly journey on foot through hostile territory.

FaustianRebellion.name: Faustian Rebellion
FaustianRebellion.def: Someone who made a Deal with the Devil decides to show the Devil where he can stick it. Forcefully.

FauxAdventureStory.name: Faux Adventure Story
FauxAdventureStory.def: A story promises adventure, but doesn't deliver.

FauxtasticVoyage.name: Fauxtastic Voyage
FauxtasticVoyage.def: Characters are promised a trip around the world, but is tricked and doesn't experience a real trip.

FavouritismFlipFlop.name: Favouritism Flip-Flop
FavouritismFlipFlop.def: Changing your opinion on something just because someone else has a different opinion.

FawltyTowersPlot.name: "Fawlty Towers" Plot
FawltyTowersPlot.def: A lie is told which must be propped up with more lies before everything cannot be sustained and goes crashing down.

FidelityTest.name: Fidelity Test
FidelityTest.def: A character tests their spouse's faithfulness to them.

FieldTripToThePast.name: Field Trip to the Past
FieldTripToThePast.def: Someone learns history by experiencing it.

FightClubbing.name: Fight Clubbing
FightClubbing.def: People meet in secret to beat each other senseless.

FightDracula.name: Fight Dracula
FightDracula.def: Previously established heroes take on Count Dracula as their latest opponent.

FightToSurvive.name: Fight to Survive
FightToSurvive.def: Characters struggle to survive a perilous situation.

FightingForAHomeland.name: Fighting for a Homeland
FightingForAHomeland.def: Group of people fight for ownership of a land to claim as their home.

TheFinalTemptation.name: The Final Temptation
TheFinalTemptation.def: A character is given a chance to abandon his difficult life for a better one, complete with imagery for the latter.

FindTheCure.name: Find the Cure
FindTheCure.def: A plot focused on finding a cure for something.

FindingJudas.name: Finding Judas
FindingJudas.def: A character willingly betrays the protagonists for benevolent reasons.

FirefightingEpisode.name: Firefighting Episode
FirefightingEpisode.def: The characters become firefighters for the duration of one story.

FirstPetStory.name: First Pet Story
FirstPetStory.def: A plot detailing a character adopting their first pet.

FishOutOfTemporalWater.name: Fish out of Temporal Water
FishOutOfTemporalWater.def: Someone is forced to adjust living outside of their original time period.

FlatlinePlotline.name: Flatline Plotline
FlatlinePlotline.def: Characters make it so they die for a certain amount of time.

FleaEpisode.name: Flea Episode
FleaEpisode.def: A character has fleas. Itchiness ensues.

FlowersForAlgernonSyndrome.name: "Flowers for Algernon" Syndrome
FlowersForAlgernonSyndrome.def: The improvements you obtain will eventually be reverted, sometimes for the best.

FlowerFromTheMountaintop.name: Flower from the Mountaintop
FlowerFromTheMountaintop.def: A rare or precious flower that has to be retrieved through a difficult mountain expedition.

AFoolAndHisNewMoneyAreSoonParted.name: A Fool and His New Money Are Soon Parted
AFoolAndHisNewMoneyAreSoonParted.def: A character becomes rich, but then ends up losing their wealth.

ForScience.name: For Science!
ForScience.def: Doing anything, no matter how unethical or bizarre, for the sake of scientific progress.

ForcedOutOfTheCloset.name: Forced Out of the Closet
ForcedOutOfTheCloset.def: People who discover or assume a character is gay and in the closet decide that the best thing to do is to publicly reveal the person's secret against their wishes.

ForgivenessRequiresDeath.name: Forgiveness Requires Death
ForgivenessRequiresDeath.def: In order to be forgiven for their crimes, the character must die.

ForgotTheCall.name: Forgot the Call
ForgotTheCall.def: A character gets amnesia and forgets that they're an action hero.

ForgottenAnniversary.name: Forgotten Anniversary
ForgottenAnniversary.def: A character forgets the anniversary of their wedding or another significant event.

FormulaBreakingEpisode.name: Formula-Breaking Episode
FormulaBreakingEpisode.def: An episode that departs from the work's usual formula.

FourthWallShutInStory.name: Fourth Wall Shut-In Story
FourthWallShutInStory.def: A creator gets trapped within their own creation.

FreakyFridayFlip.name: "Freaky Friday" Flip
FreakyFridayFlip.def: Two people get their brains switched and have to find a way to get their minds restored to the proper bodies.

FreeTheFrogs.name: Free the Frogs
FreeTheFrogs.def: Protesting against frogs being dissected in science class.

FrequentlyBrokenUnbreakableVow.name: Frequently-Broken Unbreakable Vow
FrequentlyBrokenUnbreakableVow.def: Someone makes The Promise or a Heroic Vow , and is forced by some circumstance or another to break it. Repeatedly.

AFriendInNeed.name: A Friend in Need
AFriendInNeed.def: A character proves their loyalty and friendship by helping their friend when it would be easier not to and other people would not blame them for not doing so.

FriendlyScheming.name: Friendly Scheming
FriendlyScheming.def: The protagonist finds out that everything that's been happening was all part of an elaborate scheme set up by their friends.

FrivolousLawsuit.name: Frivolous Lawsuit
FrivolousLawsuit.def: Someone makes a lawsuit over a ridiculously petty slight.

FromBeyondTheFourthWall.name: From Beyond the Fourth Wall
FromBeyondTheFourthWall.def: A character receives help from the author or the viewer.

FromNewYorkToNowhere.name: From New York to Nowhere
FromNewYorkToNowhere.def: A character moves from a big city to a small town.

FromNobodyToNightmare.name: From Nobody to Nightmare
FromNobodyToNightmare.def: An insignificant loser becomes the scariest villain alive.

FromZeroToHero.name: From Zero to Hero
FromZeroToHero.def: An insignificant person becomes a hero worthy of honor.

FullyAbsorbedFinale.name: Fully Absorbed Finale
FullyAbsorbedFinale.def: A show that didn't end with a Grand Finale is given a final episode of sorts by having the story wrapped up in an episode of a spinoff or a show taking place in the same continuity.

FumblingTheGauntlet.name: Fumbling the Gauntlet
FumblingTheGauntlet.def: A character's action against another character in an unfamiliar culture is construed as a challenge to a duel, lethal or not.

TheFunInFuneral.name: The "Fun" in "Funeral"
TheFunInFuneral.def: Wacky antics happen during a person's funeral.

FundraiserCarnival.name: Fundraiser Carnival
FundraiserCarnival.def: The characters organize a carnival to raise money for a charity or other cause.

GambitRoulette.name: Gambit Roulette
GambitRoulette.def: A convoluted plan that hinges on unpredictable factors actually succeeds.

TheGameNeverStopped.name: The Game Never Stopped
TheGameNeverStopped.def: The protagonists think the fake test has ended. It hasn't.

TheGamePlaysYou.name: The Game Plays You
TheGamePlaysYou.def: A seemingly harmless game haunts or harms the people that play it.

GameShowAppearance.name: Game Show Appearance
GameShowAppearance.def: Characters appear on a real or fictitious game show.

GarageBand.name: Garage Band
GarageBand.def: A ragtag group of characters start their own band.

GarageSale.name: Garage Sale
GarageSale.def: To earn money, the characters sell some of their old junk in a garage sale/yard sale/etc.

GarrulousGrowth.name: Garrulous Growth
GarrulousGrowth.def: A sentient, talking protrusion that usually wants to take over the human body on which it grows.

GenderInvadingSleepovers.name: Gender-Invading Sleepovers
GenderInvadingSleepovers.def: Boys try to get in to a girls-only sleepover, or vice-versa.

GenderNormativeParentPlot.name: "Gender-Normative Parent" Plot
GenderNormativeParentPlot.def: A boy has an interest in a "girlish" hobby, and his father pushes him to follow a "manly" one.

GenerationalSaga.name: Generational Saga
GenerationalSaga.def: A tale spanning multiple generations of the same family.

GenerationalTrauma.name: Generational Trauma
GenerationalTrauma.def: Conflict arises due to unresolved baggage passed down from generation to generation.

GenocideBackfire.name: Genocide Backfire
GenocideBackfire.def: An evil tyrant or regime seeks to wipe out a people because they fear they are a threat to their power. Unfortunately for them, someone manages to survive.

GetBackToTheFuture.name: Get Back to the Future
GetBackToTheFuture.def: Someone is sent to the past and has to find their way back.

GettingMyOwnRoomPlot.name: "Getting My Own Room" Plot
GettingMyOwnRoomPlot.def: A child who has always shared a room with siblings finally gets their own room.

GettingReadyForBedPlot.name: "Getting Ready for Bed" Plot
GettingReadyForBedPlot.def: An episode set late at night, where a character readies themselves for sleep... Or the point is getting a restless character to sleep.

GettingSickDeliberately.name: Getting Sick Deliberately
GettingSickDeliberately.def: A character tries to get themselves sick so that they can get out of an obligation.

GirlsBehindBars.name: Girls Behind Bars
GirlsBehindBars.def: A female character is thrown into a women's prison, which is often played for titillation.

GirlsVsBoysPlot.name: Girls vs. Boys Plot
GirlsVsBoysPlot.def: Boys and girls battle for supremacy.

GivingRadioToTheRomans.name: Giving Radio to the Romans
GivingRadioToTheRomans.def: Giving modern technology to people in the past.

GladiatorRevolt.name: Gladiator Revolt
GladiatorRevolt.def: Gladiators rebel against those that force them to fight.

GoAmongMadPeople.name: Go Among Mad People
GoAmongMadPeople.def: A sane person is committed to a mental institution, and needs to convince the staff that they're not crazy.

GodAndSatanAreBothJerks.name: God and Satan Are Both Jerks
GodAndSatanAreBothJerks.def: Neither the forces of Hell nor the forces of Heaven have anything good in mind for humanity.

GodForADay.name: God for a Day
GodForADay.def: Status as a deity proves to be too much responsibility and absolute power corrupts.

GoingNative.name: Going Native
GoingNative.def: A character adopts the customs and morality of a group which they were originally sent to infiltrate.

GoingToSeeTheElephant.name: Going to See the Elephant
GoingToSeeTheElephant.def: A young character travels the world to go see something new and exotic, often learning life lessons along the way.

GoldFever.name: Gold Fever
GoldFever.def: A group of characters fall prey to greed and turn on each other while on the hunt for gold or some other fabulous treasure.

GondorCallsForAid.name: Gondor Calls for Aid
GondorCallsForAid.def: The hero prepares for an epic battle by recruiting every friend, ally, enemy, and so on who is willing to help them in the fight.

GottaHaveItGonnaStealIt.name: Gotta Have It, Gonna Steal It
GottaHaveItGonnaStealIt.def: Someone wants something trendy but isn't allowed/can't afford it, so they steal (or attempt to steal) it.

GovernmentConspiracy.name: Government Conspiracy
GovernmentConspiracy.def: A secret project run by a government organization, such as the military or an intelligence agency.

GrandFinale.name: Grand Finale
GrandFinale.def: The last episode of the series that serves to bring the show's story to a proper conclusion.

GrandTheftMe.name: Grand Theft Me
GrandTheftMe.def: Taking control of someone's body to make them do bad things.

GrassIsGreener.name: Grass Is Greener
GrassIsGreener.def: A character who longs to leave their terrible life behind to go somewhere they think is better.

GreatEscape.name: Great Escape
GreatEscape.def: Someone has been thrown in prison, and must now make good their escape.

TheGreatRepair.name: The Great Repair
TheGreatRepair.def: Characters have to repair a vehicle of some kind in order to escape the place where they're trapped.

TheGreatestStoryNeverTold.name: The Greatest Story Never Told
TheGreatestStoryNeverTold.def: A character does something heroic or awesome, but nobody hears about it.

GroundhogDayLoop.name: "Groundhog Day" Loop
GroundhogDayLoop.def: Someone ends up trapped in a loop where they experience the same day repeatedly.

GuardingThePortal.name: Guarding the Portal
GuardingThePortal.def: Heroes guard a dimensional portal to make sure nothing goes in or out.

GuessWhoImMarrying.name: Guess Who I'm Marrying?
GuessWhoImMarrying.def: A character's single parent has found someone. Unfortunately, that someone is anything but good for the character, and now they need to stop this!

GuiltyUntilSomeoneElseIsGuilty.name: Guilty Until Someone Else Is Guilty
GuiltyUntilSomeoneElseIsGuilty.def: A suspect can only be proven innocent by finding the true culprit.

GymClassRopeClimb.name: Gym Class Rope Climb
GymClassRopeClimb.def: An activity in gym class that involves students having to climb up a rope hanging from the ceiling.

HalfwayPlotSwitch.name: Halfway Plot Switch
HalfwayPlotSwitch.def: Abandoning one plot in favor of another.

HandcuffedBriefcase.name: Handcuffed Briefcase
HandcuffedBriefcase.def: A briefcase is holding something so important, the person holding it has it handcuffed to their wrist.

HappyEndingMassage.name: Happy-Ending Massage
HappyEndingMassage.def: A massage session turns into something quite a lot steamier than that.

HarbingerOfImpendingDoom.name: Harbinger of Impending Doom
HarbingerOfImpendingDoom.def: A character tries to warn everyone about something from which they barely escaped, but they just dither until it shows up anyway.

HastilyHiddenMacGuffin.name: Hastily Hidden MacGuffin
HastilyHiddenMacGuffin.def: A valuable stolen object, hidden to avoid detection by the authorities (or rival thieves, or whichever party is trying to take it), which the thieves then must scramble to get back.

HaveYouTriedNotBeingAMonster.name: Have You Tried Not Being a Monster?
HaveYouTriedNotBeingAMonster.def: The familial rejection in this one is supposed to be well-meaning (assuming the family loves the queer person), but it carries the implication that the queer person can and should change.

HeKnowsTooMuch.name: He Knows Too Much
HeKnowsTooMuch.def: Killing someone for getting even a smidgen close to discovering a secret they can't be allowed to know.

HeadbuttingHeroes.name: Headbutting Heroes
HeadbuttingHeroes.def: Two heroes who are anything but on the best of terms with each other.

HellInvadesHeaven.name: Hell Invades Heaven
HellInvadesHeaven.def: The Legions of Hell invade Heaven itself.

HellOnEarth.name: Hell on Earth
HellOnEarth.def: The Legions of Hell invade the mortal realm.

HerCodeNameWasMarySue.name: Her Code Name Was "Mary Sue"
HerCodeNameWasMarySue.def: Someone tells a story about themselves that depicts them as a ludicrously overpowered badass.

HeroForADay.name: Hero for a Day
HeroForADay.def: A hero loses their powers, allowing someone else to take their place until their powers return.

HeroOnHiatus.name: Hero on Hiatus
HeroOnHiatus.def: The hero is temporarily taken out of action.

HeroesGoneFishing.name: Heroes Gone Fishing
HeroesGoneFishing.def: The good guys take a break from heroics to do the same pastimes and activities normal people do.

HeroicRematch.name: Heroic Rematch
HeroicRematch.def: After being defeated the first time, the hero is ready for Round Two against the villain.

HerosEvilPredecessor.name: Hero's Evil Predecessor
HerosEvilPredecessor.def: Someone had the hero's mantle or powers before them, but they have since gone evil, and now the hero now has to deal with them.

HeroStageShow.name: Hero Stage Show
HeroStageShow.def: The main character(s) must take younger siblings to a children's stage show.

HiccupHijinks.name: Hiccup Hijinks
HiccupHijinks.def: An episode centered on trying to get rid of hiccups.

HiredToHuntYourself.name: Hired to Hunt Yourself
HiredToHuntYourself.def: A person sent to hunt down The Mole actually is The Mole.

TheHomewardJourney.name: The Homeward Journey
TheHomewardJourney.def: The plot revolves around a character's journey to get back home .

HorribleCampingTrip.name: Horrible Camping Trip
HorribleCampingTrip.def: Someone goes on a camping trip that ends badly.

HourglassPlot.name: Hourglass Plot
HourglassPlot.def: Two characters on opposite ends of the moral or at least conflict spectrum change roles over the course, but are still opposed to each other.

HouseFire.name: House Fire
HouseFire.def: A plot revolves around a character's house getting damaged/destroyed in a fire and dealing with the aftermath.

HowDadMetMom.name: How Dad Met Mom
HowDadMetMom.def: The story of how a character's parents met each other and fell in love.

HumanityOnTrial.name: Humanity on Trial
HumanityOnTrial.def: An alien or supernatural race decides to put the human race on trial, with our continued existence on the line.

HuntingTheRogue.name: Hunting the Rogue
HuntingTheRogue.def: A rogue agent deserts from an organization they served and they're chased as a result.

HurryingHomeForTheHolidays.name: Hurrying Home for the Holidays
HurryingHomeForTheHolidays.def: A character needs to get somewhere in time to celebrate a holiday.

HybridizationPlot.name: Hybridization Plot
HybridizationPlot.def: A large portion of the plot, or a character's motivation, focuses around creating a hybrid.

HyperlinkStory.name: Hyperlink Story
HyperlinkStory.def: Several unconnected and unrelated storylines gradually and slowly merge into a single overarching storyline.

HypnoFool.name: Hypno Fool
HypnoFool.def: A person is hypnotized and Hilarity Ensues before it can be undone.

IAmWho.name: I Am Who?
IAmWho.def: The protagonist discovers their heroic destiny which had been kept secret from them.

IWillFindYou.name: I Will Find You
IWillFindYou.def: A character is searching for a loved one who has been kidnapped or has otherwise gone missing.

IWishItWereReal.name: I Wish It Were Real
IWishItWereReal.def: Character's favorite toy/video game/show becomes real.

IdentityImpersonator.name: Identity Impersonator
IdentityImpersonator.def: A superhero protects their secret identity by appearing in public with someone pretending to be their alter ego.

InAnotherMansShoes.name: In Another Man's Shoes
InAnotherMansShoes.def: Characters are forced to experience life through another's perspective.

InDefenceOfStorytelling.name: In Defence of Storytelling
InDefenceOfStorytelling.def: A plot that affirms the importance of storytelling.

InMediasRes.name: In Medias Res
InMediasRes.def: The story doesn't start at the beginning; it's either in the middle or at the end.

InWithTheInCrowd.name: In with the "In" Crowd
InWithTheInCrowd.def: A character is invited into a popular, exclusive crowd - but they have to leave their friends behind.

InadequateInheritor.name: Inadequate Inheritor
InadequateInheritor.def: The potential heir is seen as unfit for the prospective inheritance.

IndyPloy.name: Indy Ploy
IndyPloy.def: Rather than having a plan ready, the hero makes up a scheme as they go along.

IneptAptitudeTest.name: Inept Aptitude Test
IneptAptitudeTest.def: A student takes an aptitude test and doesn't get the result they wanted and/or expected.

TheInfiltration.name: The Infiltration
TheInfiltration.def: A character must get "inside" a bad-guy organization and pass as a bad guy to accomplish a goal.

InnocenceLost.name: Innocence Lost
InnocenceLost.def: An innocent character is exposed to true evil, or the uglier side of the world, for the first time.

InnocentBystanderSeries.name: Innocent Bystander Series
InnocentBystanderSeries.def: A series that focuses solely on citizens rather than the superheroes or villains.

TheInspectorIsComing.name: The Inspector Is Coming
TheInspectorIsComing.def: A place of business prepares for a visit from an inspector or critic.

InsideAComputerSystem.name: Inside a Computer System
InsideAComputerSystem.def: Characters go inside a virtual world contained within a computer.

InstantBookDeal.name: Instant Book Deal
InstantBookDeal.def: A character writes a book that immediately becomes published and an overnight success.

IntergenerationalFriendship.name: Intergenerational Friendship
IntergenerationalFriendship.def: Friendship between two people who have a significant age gap.

InternetSafetyAesop.name: Internet Safety Aesop
InternetSafetyAesop.def: A character does something irresponsible on the internet and has to deal with the repercussions.

InterruptedCooldownHug.name: Interrupted Cooldown Hug
InterruptedCooldownHug.def: A character who has been given a Cooldown Hug is attacked by a Trigger-Happy Leeroy Jenkins .

IntoxicationEnsues.name: Intoxication Ensues
IntoxicationEnsues.def: An otherwise straitlaced character accidentally ingests a drug, alcohol, or too much of their prescribed medication, and Hilarity Ensues .

IntrepidFictioneer.name: Intrepid Fictioneer
IntrepidFictioneer.def: Characters breach internal fourth walls to go on adventures in books, films, etc.

InventedIndividual.name: Invented Individual
InventedIndividual.def: Somebody makes up an imaginary person and eventually has to give up the made-up person by "killing" them.

InvisibleMainCharacter.name: Invisible Main Character
InvisibleMainCharacter.def: A story where the main character temporarily becomes invisible.

InvoluntaryCharityDonation.name: Involuntary Charity Donation
InvoluntaryCharityDonation.def: Stealing from a villain and donating it to charity.

IrritationIsTheSincerestFormOfFlattery.name: Irritation Is the Sincerest Form of Flattery
IrritationIsTheSincerestFormOfFlattery.def: A character starts to imitate someone they admire.

ItsACostumePartyISwear.name: It's a Costume Party, I Swear!
ItsACostumePartyISwear.def: A character is tricked into showing up in costume at what they are led to believe is a costume party.

ItsAWonderfulPlot.name: It's a Wonderful Plot
ItsAWonderfulPlot.def: Someone is shown what the world would be like if they never existed.

ItsPersonal.name: It's Personal
ItsPersonal.def: Something bad has happened to a loved one, and now the hero wants the villain responsible taken down more than ever!

JackieRobinsonStory.name: Jackie Robinson Story
JackieRobinsonStory.def: Someone tries to be the first of their race or sex in a field occupied solely by white males.

JawsAttackParody.name: "Jaws" Attack Parody
JawsAttackParody.def: A shark (or any other dangerous creature) threatens a small-town community, parodying the film Jaws 1 .

JekyllAndHyde.name: Jekyll & Hyde
JekyllAndHyde.def: A good person who transforms into a villainous alter ego.

JigsawPuzzlePlot.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Plot
JigsawPuzzlePlot.def: A plot that's fed to the audience a little bit at a time.

JokerJury.name: Joker Jury
JokerJury.def: The heroes' enemies put them on trial for the "crime" of always thwarting their evil schemes.

JourneyOfReclamation.name: Journey of Reclamation
JourneyOfReclamation.def: A character seeks to regain something they lost.

JourneyToTheCenterOfTheMind.name: Journey to the Center of the Mind
JourneyToTheCenterOfTheMind.def: A character enters the physical manifestation of someone's mind.

JudgmentOfSolomon.name: Judgment of Solomon
JudgmentOfSolomon.def: Two people claim to be the true owner of something, and the judge chooses to split it to decide the true owner.

JumpingOffTheSlipperySlope.name: Jumping Off the Slippery Slope
JumpingOffTheSlipperySlope.def: A character goes evil very quickly after doing some warned-against but otherwise innocuous thing.

TheJungleOpera.name: The Jungle Opera
TheJungleOpera.def: A story that takes place in undiscovered or semidiscovered country in the present or "recent" past.

JuryOfTheDamned.name: Jury of the Damned
JuryOfTheDamned.def: A trial in which the jury is composed of the spirits of the worst people.

JustFineWithoutYou.name: Just Fine Without You
JustFineWithoutYou.def: A character leaves and everyone pretends that things are going fine without them.

JustOneExtraTicket.name: Just One Extra Ticket
JustOneExtraTicket.def: A character acquires an extra ticket to an event, and must choose which friend to invite and which to exclude.

JustSoStory.name: "Just So" Story
JustSoStory.def: An often mythic story that explains why things are a certain way.

JustThinkOfThePotential.name: Just Think of the Potential!
JustThinkOfThePotential.def: A character has a vision for the future and tries to share their vision with others.

KafkaKomedy.name: Kafka Komedy
KafkaKomedy.def: A story where the character's misfortune and misery are played for Black Comedy .

KangarooCourt.name: Kangaroo Court
KangarooCourt.def: A trial that doesn't follow the proper procedure of determining whether someone is guilty or innocent of the crime they've been accused of committing.

KansasCityShuffle.name: Kansas City Shuffle
KansasCityShuffle.def: A con where the mark figures out an obvious scam only to fall right into a different one.

KeystoneArmy.name: Keystone Army
KeystoneArmy.def: If one critical component is damaged, an entire army will instantly be destroyed.

KidsPlayMatchBreaker.name: Kids Play Match Breaker
KidsPlayMatchBreaker.def: The opposite of Kids Play Matchmaker . The children of a single parent try to sabotage any new relationships.

KidsPlayMatchmaker.name: Kids Play Matchmaker
KidsPlayMatchmaker.def: The children of single parents decide to try to get their parents together.

KillMeNowOrForeverStayYourHand.name: Kill Me Now, or Forever Stay Your Hand
KillMeNowOrForeverStayYourHand.def: The hero offers their antagonist a chance to kill them, knowing the other person isn't so far gone as to commit murder.

KilledToUpholdTheMasquerade.name: Killed to Uphold the Masquerade
KilledToUpholdTheMasquerade.def: Someone is killed to prevent them from exposing the existence of supernatural beings.

KillingForATissueSample.name: Killing for a Tissue Sample
KillingForATissueSample.def: Killing someone in order to use their dead body for scientific purposes.

KingmakerScenario.name: Kingmaker Scenario
KingmakerScenario.def: When a player cannot win, they decide which side does.

KudzuPlot.name: Kudzu Plot
KudzuPlot.def: Many plot threads are started at once, and are not resolved for a long time, if at all.

LastFertileRegion.name: Last Fertile Region
LastFertileRegion.def: The last place to support life in an otherwise barren world.

LateToTheTragedy.name: Late to the Tragedy
LateToTheTragedy.def: Something bad has happened in the location, and the character arrives too late to prevent it.

LeaveYourQuestTest.name: "Leave Your Quest" Test
LeaveYourQuestTest.def: The hero is tested by being tempted into abandoning their mission.

LedByTheOutsider.name: Led by the Outsider
LedByTheOutsider.def: The hero becomes a leader of another group.

LegionOfDoom.name: Legion of Doom
LegionOfDoom.def: Several of the hero's enemies team up in a plot to have their revenge against the hero.

LikeADuckTakesToWater.name: Like a Duck Takes to Water
LikeADuckTakesToWater.def: A character has knowledge that makes them able to adapt to another time/world.

LikeYouWereDying.name: Like You Were Dying
LikeYouWereDying.def: A character radically changes their behavior because they're dying.

LiteralTransformativeExperience.name: Literal Transformative Experience
LiteralTransformativeExperience.def: A character undergoes a drastic transformation and sees their personality change as a result of their experiences.

LoanShark.name: Loan Shark
LoanShark.def: You shouldn't have borrowed money from these guys, because they will do anything to make you pay them back - with interest!

LonelyAtTheTop.name: Lonely at the Top
LonelyAtTheTop.def: A character gets everything they want, but loses everything and everyone they loved in the process.

LongGame.name: Long Game
LongGame.def: A master plan that takes a long time to complete.

LostOrphanedRoyalty.name: Lost Orphaned Royalty
LostOrphanedRoyalty.def: An orphan turns out to be descended from royalty.

LostWeddingRing.name: Lost Wedding Ring
LostWeddingRing.def: The ring goes missing right before the wedding.

LotteryOfDoom.name: Lottery of Doom
LotteryOfDoom.def: A lottery or other game that you really, really don't want to win.

LotusEaterMachine.name: Lotus-Eater Machine
LotusEaterMachine.def: Someone is trapped in a dream-like fantasy where everything's the way it should be to make the person happy and content.

LoveTriangle.name: Love Triangle
LoveTriangle.def: Two people love the same person, and only one person can have them.

LowerDeckEpisode.name: Lower-Deck Episode
LowerDeckEpisode.def: Minor supporting characters shift into spotlight for one episode.

MacGuffinEscortMission.name: MacGuffin Escort Mission
MacGuffinEscortMission.def: The good guys get the MacGuffin early, so the rest of the story is about them transporting it somewhere else without losing it.

MachoDisasterExpedition.name: Macho Disaster Expedition
MachoDisasterExpedition.def: Men and women go on a stereotypically male-oriented activity. The guys fail miserably due to arrogance and have to be saved by the women.

MadScienceFair.name: Mad Science Fair
MadScienceFair.def: A Science Fair held by Mad Scientists .

MaddenIntoMisanthropy.name: Madden Into Misanthropy
MaddenIntoMisanthropy.def: The annoyance of having to put up with certain people causes a person to develop a hatred of humanity.

MadeASlave.name: Made a Slave
MadeASlave.def: A character is sold or forced into slavery, and must escape, be rescued or learn to live with it.

TheMagicComesBack.name: The Magic Comes Back
TheMagicComesBack.def: In a setting where magic has vanished, the magic ends up returning.

TheMagicGoesAway.name: The Magic Goes Away
TheMagicGoesAway.def: A story with magic in the setting ends with all the magic disappearing.

TheMagnificentSevenSamurai.name: The Magnificent Seven Samurai
TheMagnificentSevenSamurai.def: A helpless community under attack hires heroes (usually seven) to protect them, a Whole-Plot Reference to Seven Samurai .

MaintainTheLie.name: Maintain the Lie
MaintainTheLie.def: Someone lies about their life and their friends have to help them keep the truth hidden.

MakeRoomForTheNewPlot.name: Make Room for the New Plot
MakeRoomForTheNewPlot.def: When one important plot element is abruptly resolved so that the characters can combat a more immediate, dangerous conflict instead.

MakeTheBearAngryAgain.name: Make the Bear Angry Again
MakeTheBearAngryAgain.def: Mother Russia has become the villain again.

MakeUpOrBreakUp.name: Make Up or Break Up
MakeUpOrBreakUp.def: A couple has to choose whether to stay together or break up.

TheMakeover.name: The Makeover
TheMakeover.def: Being transformed from ugly (or mundane) to beautiful.

MakingTheMasterpiece.name: Making the Masterpiece
MakingTheMasterpiece.def: A dramatized version of how a book, painting, movie, etc. came to be made.

MalignantPlotTumor.name: Malignant Plot Tumor
MalignantPlotTumor.def: What seems to be a minor plot line at first ends up overtaking the others.

MallSanta.name: Mall Santa
MallSanta.def: Someone dresses up as Santa Claus at the mall.

ManInTheIronMask.name: Man in the Iron Mask
ManInTheIronMask.def: A character is held prisoner by another, even though the captive threatens the captor by his very existence.

MandatoryUnretirement.name: Mandatory Unretirement
MandatoryUnretirement.def: A character is forced to do a job they have already given up.

MasqueradeBall.name: Masquerade Ball
MasqueradeBall.def: A dance where a person can wear Gorgeous Period Dress and a mask to hide their identity.

MayTheFarceBeWithYou.name: May the Farce Be with You

MesACrowd.name: Me's a Crowd
MesACrowd.def: When someone tries to clone themselves.

MeetYourEarlyInstallmentWeirdness.name: Meet Your Early-Installment Weirdness
MeetYourEarlyInstallmentWeirdness.def: Characters in a Long Runner meet themselves the way they looked when the run first began.

MentalStory.name: Mental Story
MentalStory.def: A story that focuses on what's going on in someone's head.

TheMigration.name: The Migration
TheMigration.def: A homeless group migrate to a new home.

MinorCrimeRevealsMajorPlot.name: Minor Crime Reveals Major Plot
MinorCrimeRevealsMajorPlot.def: Someone investigates a minor crime, but finds something much bigger going on behind it.

MissConception.name: Miss Conception
MissConception.def: Someone has inaccurate information on sex and how it works.

MissingStepsPlan.name: Missing Steps Plan
MissingStepsPlan.def: The only parts of the plan that were thought out were how to start the plan and the plan's intended result.

MissionFromGod.name: Mission from God
MissionFromGod.def: When someone believes their goals were given to them by orders from God.

MobDebt.name: Mob Debt
MobDebt.def: A sympathetic person(s) owes money to a criminal entity.

MobySchtick.name: Moby Schtick
MobySchtick.def: A Whole-Plot Reference to Moby-Dick and its story of a monomaniacal captain hunting a whale.

MockGuffin.name: MockGuffin
MockGuffin.def: A MacGuffin that turns out to be worthless.

MocksteryTale.name: Mockstery Tale
MocksteryTale.def: One or more characters try to solve a mystery but then the mystery turns out to be nonexistent, unimportant, or unsolvable and it turns into psychological horror or similar.

ModelScam.name: Model Scam
ModelScam.def: A woman is lured into a trap (usually involving rape) under the pretense of a model shoot.

MonsterIsAMommy.name: Monster Is a Mommy
MonsterIsAMommy.def: A frightening creature turns out to be a parent.

MonsterProtectionRacket.name: Monster Protection Racket
MonsterProtectionRacket.def: A monster or villain attacks so that someone they're in league with can profit from stopping them.

MoreThanMindControl.name: More than Mind Control
MoreThanMindControl.def: A character did something evil because of Brainwashing but they also did it willingly, if only slightly.

MovieMakingMess.name: Movie-Making Mess
MovieMakingMess.def: Characters attempt to make their own movie, Hilarity Ensues .

TheMovingExperience.name: The Moving Experience
TheMovingExperience.def: A character thinks their best friend is moving to another town and struggles to say goodbye.

MovingIsTemporary.name: Moving Is Temporary
MovingIsTemporary.def: Characters move to another house for the duration of an episode or story arc, but then go right back to their old home.

MovingTheGoalposts.name: Moving the Goalposts
MovingTheGoalposts.def: Getting out of honoring one's part of an agreement by adding a last-minute specification to the deal.

Mundanization.name: Mundanization
Mundanization.def: Putting the cast of a (relatively) fantastical setting into a contemporary, "normal" one.

MusicalEpisode.name: Musical Episode
MusicalEpisode.def: An episode full of scenes where the characters sing songs.

MyBiologicalClockIsTicking.name: My Biological Clock Is Ticking
MyBiologicalClockIsTicking.def: When a woman gets to be of a certain age, getting married and/or having babies right away becomes of utmost concern to her.

MyDeathIsJustTheBeginning.name: My Death Is Just the Beginning
MyDeathIsJustTheBeginning.def: Villain lets themselves die so their plan may continue.

NastyParty.name: Nasty Party
NastyParty.def: A person or group of people are invited to a party or any other form of get-together. However, it's just an excuse to get them all together and kill them.

NeighborhoodWatchPlot.name: Neighborhood Watch Plot
NeighborhoodWatchPlot.def: A plot that revolves around the characters organizing a neighborhood watch program.

NeverBringAFriendToAnAudition.name: Never Bring a Friend to an Audition
NeverBringAFriendToAnAudition.def: A character's family member or friend accidentally gets a role that they were auditioning for.

NeverLearnedToRead.name: Never Learned to Read
NeverLearnedToRead.def: A character is revealed to be illiterate and in many cases will try to overcome it.

NeverLendToAFriend.name: Never Lend to a Friend
NeverLendToAFriend.def: A character loans a friend some money, but the friend neglects to pay them back or the character constantly reminds their friend that they still owe them money.

NeverWinTheLottery.name: Never Win the Lottery
NeverWinTheLottery.def: A character wins the lottery, or tricked into thinking they won the lottery.

NewAbilityAddiction.name: New Ability Addiction
NewAbilityAddiction.def: A character gets a new skill or piece of kit and has the urge to use it.

NewNeighborsPlot.name: "New Neighbors" Plot
NewNeighborsPlot.def: New characters move into the neighborhood, with the plot focussing on the established characters meeting them for the first time, for better or worse.

NewPowersAsThePlotDemands.name: New Powers as the Plot Demands
NewPowersAsThePlotDemands.def: A character will spontaneously demonstrate new abilities whenever they're needed for the plot.

NewSuperPower.name: New Super Power
NewSuperPower.def: A character gains a new superpower.

NightmareOfNormality.name: Nightmare of Normality
NightmareOfNormality.def: A supernatural character is deluded into thinking that they're ordinary and must find a way to awaken from the illusion.

NitroExpress.name: Nitro Express
NitroExpress.def: Hauling unstable explosives over dangerous terrain. What could possibly go wrong?

NoDoubtTheYearsHaveChangedMe.name: No Doubt the Years Have Changed Me
NoDoubtTheYearsHaveChangedMe.def: A character is unrecognizable after being away for many years.

NoGuyWantsAnAmazon.name: No Guy Wants an Amazon
NoGuyWantsAnAmazon.def: Men don't want to be with women who can beat them up.

NoPlotNoProblem.name: No Plot? No Problem!
NoPlotNoProblem.def: Forsaking any plot or character development so that the game is purely about the gameplay itself.

NoSympathy.name: No Sympathy
NoSympathy.def: A character who doesn't feel pity or sorrow for other people's misfortunes.

NoahsStoryArc.name: Noah's Story Arc
NoahsStoryArc.def: Evacuating a large population of people and animals in order to survive an impending disaster.

NoirEpisode.name: Noir Episode
NoirEpisode.def: Episode shot in the style of film noir . Black-and-white visuals and first-person narrations are usually mandatory.

NonProtagonistResolver.name: Non-Protagonist Resolver
NonProtagonistResolver.def: The conflict is not resolved by the protagonist, but by someone else instead.

NotHimself.name: Not Himself
NotHimself.def: A character isn't acting like they normally would, usually as a result of an Evil Twin , "Freaky Friday" Flip , or Demonic Possession .

NotInMyBackyard.name: Not in My Backyard!
NotInMyBackyard.def: A construction project that is to be built on the site of something of value to the townsfolk (i.e. a protected area for a threatened or near-threatened species, an historic neighborhood, or just their neighborhood) is met with opposition from said townsfolk.

NotJustATournament.name: Not Just a Tournament
NotJustATournament.def: A tournament with a sinister ulterior purpose.

NotSoForgottenBirthday.name: Not-So-Forgotten Birthday
NotSoForgottenBirthday.def: The other characters pretend to forget someone's birthday to ensure that they're surprised by the surprise party.

NotSoImaginaryFriend.name: Not-So-Imaginary Friend
NotSoImaginaryFriend.def: What was assumed to be an imaginary friend turns out to be a real person.

OddlyCommonRarity.name: Oddly Common Rarity
OddlyCommonRarity.def: A person is supposed to be unique, but there are a lot of people who share many of the attributes and characteristics they have.

OffTheWagon.name: Off the Wagon
OffTheWagon.def: An alcoholic or drug addict tries to quit but then starts it up again.

OffToSeeTheWizard.name: Off to See the Wizard
OffToSeeTheWizard.def: Plots inspired by or parodying The Wonderful Wizard of Oz , especially the 1939 film adaptation .

AnOfferYouCantRefuse.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
AnOfferYouCantRefuse.def: An offer where the choices are, "Accept or die"

OlderHeroVsYoungerVillain.name: Older Hero vs. Younger Villain
OlderHeroVsYoungerVillain.def: The hero is old or borderline old, while the villain is relatively young.

OnTheMoney.name: On the Money
OnTheMoney.def: Characters in need of money find a contest, inheritance, or job offering the exact amount they need.

OneCrazyNight.name: One Crazy Night
OneCrazyNight.def: Plans for a quiet peaceful night turns into a problem that keeps getting worse.

TheOneWhoMadeItOut.name: The One Who Made It Out
TheOneWhoMadeItOut.def: A character who managed to rise above their less-than-stellar origins and become a success.

TheOnlyOne.name: The Only One
TheOnlyOne.def: The hero has to solve the problem because no one else can do it.

OutOfGenreExperience.name: Out-of-Genre Experience
OutOfGenreExperience.def: A temporary (and jarring) switch of genres.

ParanormalEpisode.name: Paranormal Episode
ParanormalEpisode.def: The characters find themselves dealing with a paranormal/supernatural situation in an otherwise mundane setting.

ParentsForADay.name: Parents for a Day
ParentsForADay.def: A baby or something like it is raised, who leaves by the end of the episode.

PassedOverInheritance.name: Passed-Over Inheritance
PassedOverInheritance.def: The deceased leaves his belongings, not to his closest family, but someone completely unexpected and usually not related.

PassedOverPromotion.name: Passed-Over Promotion
PassedOverPromotion.def: A character isn't promoted upon opportunity, regardless of how qualified they may be.

PassionPlay.name: Passion Play
PassionPlay.def: A re-telling of the story of the Passion of Jesus Christ .

PassingTheTorch.name: Passing the Torch
PassingTheTorch.def: The story ends with the hero choosing someone to continue their legacy.

PatiencePlot.name: Patience Plot
PatiencePlot.def: One or more characters have to wait for something.

PeerPressureMakesYouEvil.name: Peer Pressure Makes You Evil
PeerPressureMakesYouEvil.def: When a character's morally shady friends influence him to lower his own moral standards.

PennyAmongDiamonds.name: Penny Among Diamonds
PennyAmongDiamonds.def: A commoner (or poor person) is thrust into rich culture without becoming rich themselves.

PeopleZoo.name: People Zoo
PeopleZoo.def: An alien zoo containing humans and other intelligent life as part of the exhibits.

PerfectionIsAddictive.name: Perfection Is Addictive
PerfectionIsAddictive.def: Once you experience complete, utter perfection, it's almost impossible to settle for anything less.

PetBabyWildAnimal.name: Pet Baby Wild Animal
PetBabyWildAnimal.def: A younger character adopts an abandoned or orphaned baby wild animal and cares for it as a beloved pet.

PhysicalTherapyPlot.name: Physical Therapy Plot
PhysicalTherapyPlot.def: A character gets severely injured to the point of disability and begins physical therapy. The character tries to become mobile again by pushing themselves physically and mentally.

PickUpBabesWithBabes.name: Pick Up Babes With Babes
PickUpBabesWithBabes.def: A man takes care of someone else's child in order to attract women.

PictureDay.name: Picture Day
PictureDay.def: Students attempt to look nice the whole school day so they will look nice for their school photo.
