Pilgrimage.name: Pilgrimage
Pilgrimage.def: A travel to Holy Ground or for a holy purpose.

PirateBooty.name: Pirate Booty
PirateBooty.def: Troves of gold and jewels plundered by pirates and buried in faraway places to await discovery.

PlagueOfGoodFortune.name: Plague of Good Fortune
PlagueOfGoodFortune.def: A character has an amazing series of good things happen to them despite not wanting it to.

PlayingBothSides.name: Playing Both Sides
PlayingBothSides.def: One organization or person plays two sides against one another.

PlayingCyrano.name: Playing Cyrano
PlayingCyrano.def: A character helps their friend impress their Love Interest by feeding them words to say through an ear microphone.

PlayingSick.name: Playing Sick
PlayingSick.def: A character fakes having an illness to get out of some obligation.

PlotDetour.name: Plot Detour
PlotDetour.def: When the characters, against all logic, ignore the main plot to pursue something unimportant.

PlotCoupon.name: Plot Coupon
PlotCoupon.def: You need this many MacGuffins to continue the storyline as it is.

PlotDrivingSecret.name: Plot-Driving Secret
PlotDrivingSecret.def: The entire plot of a work depends on no one knowing the truth.

PlotImmunity.name: Plot Immunity
PlotImmunity.def: Certain characters won't die or leave because they are needed for the plot.

PlotIncitingInfidelity.name: Plot-Inciting Infidelity
PlotIncitingInfidelity.def: When the plot of a story is kickstarted by having the protagonist catch their partner cheating on them.

PlotLineCrossover.name: Plotline Crossover
PlotLineCrossover.def: Two different plotlines become important to each other.

PlotTailoredToTheParty.name: Plot Tailored to the Party
PlotTailoredToTheParty.def: Each protagonist has to overcome an obstacle specifically matched to their specialty.

PlotTriggeringDeath.name: Plot-Triggering Death
PlotTriggeringDeath.def: A character's death at the outset of a story puts its main plot into motion.

PlotTriggeringBook.name: Plot-Triggering Book
PlotTriggeringBook.def: A character either discovers a book or is given one which kicks off the plot.

PlotTumor.name: Plot Tumor
PlotTumor.def: A storyline or plot device that begins to eclipse the entire work.

PoisonAndCureGambit.name: Poison and Cure Gambit
PoisonAndCureGambit.def: Manipulating someone into doing what you want by poisoning them and refusing to give them the antidote until they do as you say.

PoliceBrutalityGambit.name: Police Brutality Gambit
PoliceBrutalityGambit.def: Someone accuses the police of Police Brutality as part of a Wounded Gazelle Gambit .

PonyTale.name: Pony Tale
PonyTale.def: A story about a girl and her horse.

PoorlyDisguisedPilot.name: Poorly Disguised Pilot
PoorlyDisguisedPilot.def: An episode focuses on a different set of characters is a clear sign that the episode is intended to serve as a pilot for a potential spinoff series.

PornWithPlot.name: Porn with Plot
PornWithPlot.def: A work that showcases porn, but does have an interesting story to tell.

PornWithoutPlot.name: Porn Without Plot
PornWithoutPlot.def: A work that exists to showcase porn instead of telling a story.

PortalBook.name: Portal Book
PortalBook.def: A book that can transport someone to the world of its story, or the location that is represented in it.

PossessiveParadise.name: Possessive Paradise
PossessiveParadise.def: A place that prevents you from leaving.

PostAdventureAdventure.name: Post-Adventure Adventure
PostAdventureAdventure.def: A story is set up by previous events that could have been an epic story of their own.

PostRobberyTrauma.name: Post-Robbery Trauma
PostRobberyTrauma.def: A character becomes paranoid after an encounter with crime.

PredatoryBusiness.name: Predatory Business
PredatoryBusiness.def: A large corporate retailer arrives to drive out the pre-existing local competition out of business.

PrematureEmpowerment.name: Premature Empowerment
PrematureEmpowerment.def: A superpowered group want to induct a new member through Super-Empowering .

Premiere.name: Premiere
Premiere.def: The first official episode of a series, which may or may not overlap with the pilot episode.

PreventTheWar.name: Prevent the War
PreventTheWar.def: Heroes try to prevent a war from occurring.

PrideBeforeAFall.name: Pride Before a Fall
PrideBeforeAFall.def: A character starts out as a insufferable jerk until something happens that causes them to become humble.

PrinceAndPauper.name: Prince and Pauper
PrinceAndPauper.def: Two identical people from different backgrounds switch lives.

PrincessForADay.name: Princess for a Day
PrincessForADay.def: When a woman dresses up as an upper-class person.

ProdigalFamily.name: Prodigal Family
ProdigalFamily.def: Estranged family members show up to complicate a character's life.

ProdigalHero.name: Prodigal Hero
ProdigalHero.def: A character runs away from home, lives in exile, and returns home to save the day.

ProductDeliveryOrdeal.name: Product Delivery Ordeal
ProductDeliveryOrdeal.def: The story of a character aiming to deliver a large, heavy and/or fragile product to someone else.

ThePromPlot.name: The Prom Plot
ThePromPlot.def: A large or significant part of a story involves students attending a prom or adults chaperoning a prom with various hijinks ensuing.

PromWrecker.name: Prom Wrecker
PromWrecker.def: A character tries to ruin the school dance.

ThePromisedLand.name: The Promised Land
ThePromisedLand.def: The place that promises to be better than where we are. Where the Grass Is Greener .

PropertyLine.name: Property Line
PropertyLine.def: A character finds out that everything their neighbor owns falls on their property line and tries to claim it for themselves.

ProtagonistJourneyToVillain.name: Protagonist Journey to Villain
ProtagonistJourneyToVillain.def: The story is about how the protagonist ends up becoming evil.

ProtectThisHouse.name: Protect This House
ProtectThisHouse.def: The hero's home comes under attack.

PupatingPeril.name: Pupating Peril
PupatingPeril.def: A cocoon is discovered, and much fear is elicited over what will eventually emerge...

PursuingParentalPerils.name: Pursuing Parental Perils
PursuingParentalPerils.def: A character decides to take up their dead parent's occupation.

PushPolling.name: Push-Polling
PushPolling.def: Manipulating a poll's result to push an agenda.

PuttingTheBandBackTogether.name: Putting the Band Back Together
PuttingTheBandBackTogether.def: A team which had previously (and permanently, it seemed) disbanded rallies together once more.

PuzzleThriller.name: Puzzle Thriller
PuzzleThriller.def: A plot centered around uncovering roles to a game.

PygmalionPlot.name: Pygmalion Plot
PygmalionPlot.def: A character falls in love with their own creation.

PygmalionSnapBack.name: Pygmalion Snap Back
PygmalionSnapBack.def: A character who was changed by another character to fit their ideals reverts to their original self.

TheQueenWillBeWatching.name: The Queen Will Be Watching
TheQueenWillBeWatching.def: Somebody very important will be in the audience at the Show Within a Show .

TheQuest.name: The Quest
TheQuest.def: The character leaves home, voluntarily or not, on a big adventure to recover something or search for someone.

QuestForAWish.name: Quest for a Wish
QuestForAWish.def: The characters go on an adventure to have a single wish granted.

QuestForIdentity.name: Quest for Identity
QuestForIdentity.def: A character tries to rediscover who they are.

QuestForSex.name: Quest for Sex
QuestForSex.def: A whole story focused on a man trying to get laid.

QuestForTheRest.name: Quest for the Rest
QuestForTheRest.def: A character who is thought to be the Last of His Kind ventures off to search for others like him.

QuestToTheWest.name: Quest to the West
QuestToTheWest.def: A character's journey is associated with them heading west.

RaceAgainstTheClock.name: Race Against the Clock
RaceAgainstTheClock.def: The heroes have to do something to stop the countdown, or else the consequences will be catastrophic.

RadioContest.name: Radio Contest
RadioContest.def: A character tries to win a prize by calling a local radio station that is holding a contest.

RadishCure.name: Radish Cure
RadishCure.def: Someone wants something forbidden, and then they're granted it in a way that puts them off of it forever.

RageAgainstTheHeavens.name: Rage Against the Heavens
RageAgainstTheHeavens.def: A character wants the gods to pay for what they've done.

RageWithinTheMachine.name: Rage Within the Machine
RageWithinTheMachine.def: A character is loyally part of a party or division linked to the government, but begins to doubt if said party/division is right about their beliefs or policies.

RagsToRoyalty.name: Rags to Royalty
RagsToRoyalty.def: A character is elevated (or restored) to nobility.

RailroadPlot.name: Railroad Plot
RailroadPlot.def: Something gets in the way of a big construction project, and this something must be destroyed to complete the project.

RampageFromANail.name: Rampage from a Nail
RampageFromANail.def: It turns out the beast was only attacking people because it had something painful stuck in a sensitive part of its body.

RandomEventsPlot.name: Random Events Plot
RandomEventsPlot.def: The circumstances that brought on the plot occurred for no reason.

RansackedRoom.name: Ransacked Room
RansackedRoom.def: A room is torn apart after the bad guys search for a MacGuffin .

RashomonStyle.name: "Rashomon"-Style
RashomonStyle.def: Multiple versions of the same story told from the perspective of different characters.

RashPromise.name: Rash Promise
RashPromise.def: A character swears to do something without much thought and must choose between keeping their word or suffering the consequences of their lack of foresight.

ReadTheFinePrint.name: Read the Fine Print
ReadTheFinePrint.def: A character signs a contract without reading the clauses in the fine print which is designed to screw them over.

ReadingIsCoolAesop.name: "Reading Is Cool" Aesop
ReadingIsCoolAesop.def: The story is about someone learning that reading doesn't have to be boring.

ARealManIsAKiller.name: A Real Man Is a Killer
ARealManIsAKiller.def: A man discovers that he must kill something in order to prove his worth.

RealWorldEpisode.name: Real-World Episode
RealWorldEpisode.def: An episode has the fictional characters end up in real life.

Really17YearsOld.name: Really 17 Years Old
Really17YearsOld.def: A minor pretends to be an adult.

RearWindowInvestigation.name: "Rear Window" Investigation
RearWindowInvestigation.def: A character suspects another character of a crime and waits for that person to leave their home so they can sneak in and look for clues or evidence.

RearWindowWitness.name: "Rear Window" Witness
RearWindowWitness.def: A character is caught in a situation where they witness a crime (or what he thinks is a crime) and is powerless to do anything to stop it.

ReassignmentBackfire.name: Reassignment Backfire
ReassignmentBackfire.def: Someone's attempt to send another person somewhere out of the way backfires when they end up back in the way.

RebuiltPedestal.name: Rebuilt Pedestal
RebuiltPedestal.def: Someone loses their respect for a hero, but starts liking them again after their idol proves that being more flawed than their fan assumed does not mean they're a bad person.

RecapByAudit.name: Recap by Audit
RecapByAudit.def: The aftermath of an event reveals or sums up what happened.

RedemptionQuest.name: Redemption Quest
RedemptionQuest.def: The villain goes on a quest to atone for their misdeeds.

RediscoveringRootsTrip.name: "Rediscovering Roots" Trip
RediscoveringRootsTrip.def: A Child of Two Worlds returns to the motherland to connect with their roots.

RefusalOfTheSecondCall.name: Refusal of the Second Call
RefusalOfTheSecondCall.def: The hero of the original is available to save the day again in the sequel, but refuses to help.

ReluctantRetiree.name: Reluctant Retiree
ReluctantRetiree.def: An elderly character who is perfectly capable, but gets forced to retire against their will anyway.

ReplacementPedestal.name: Replacement Pedestal
ReplacementPedestal.def: Someone loses their respect for a hero and finds somebody else to take their place as their role model.

RescueArc.name: Rescue Arc
RescueArc.def: A story arc centered around saving someone's life.

RescuedFromTheUnderworld.name: Rescued from the Underworld
RescuedFromTheUnderworld.def: Rescuing someone who is trapped in the afterlife.

RestartTheWorld.name: Restart the World
RestartTheWorld.def: The world is just too far gone, so the only way to save it is to destroy it and start over.

RestrictedRescueOperation.name: Restricted Rescue Operation
RestrictedRescueOperation.def: Someone is trying to help despite restrictions.

RevanchistPrecursors.name: Revanchist Precursors
RevanchistPrecursors.def: The Precursors are coming back, and they're not happy about being gone.

RevealingCoverup.name: Revealing Cover-Up
RevealingCoverup.def: Someone's attempt to hide something just makes it more obvious.

RevengeOfTheNerd.name: Revenge of the Nerd
RevengeOfTheNerd.def: A unbelievably hot woman seduces the guy who made fun of her in school as a nerdy wallflower, then rejects and humiliates him.

RightfulKingReturns.name: Rightful King Returns
RightfulKingReturns.def: The proper ruler comes back to fix everything after things have gone to hell in their absence.

RipVanWinkle.name: Rip Van Winkle
RipVanWinkle.def: A character sleeps for several decades.

RiseAndFallGangsterArc.name: "Rise and Fall" Gangster Arc
RiseAndFallGangsterArc.def: A story arc that depicts a gangster rising to, and then falling from, power.

RiseOfZitboy.name: Rise of Zitboy
RiseOfZitboy.def: A teenager freaks out over having acne.

RiverOfInsanity.name: River of Insanity
RiverOfInsanity.def: Any river voyage or wilderness journey is a doomed expedition in which the characters alternately die, go mad, get lost, go native, or otherwise barely live to tell the tale.

RoadTripPlot.name: Road Trip Plot
RoadTripPlot.def: Everyone goes on a road trip. Hilarity Ensues .

RoadTripRomance.name: Road Trip Romance
RoadTripRomance.def: Two characters traveling together eventually fall in love.

RoaringRampageOfRescue.name: Roaring Rampage of Rescue
RoaringRampageOfRescue.def: The character stops at nothing to save their loved one, including mowing anyone in their path.

RoaringRampageOfRevenge.name: Roaring Rampage of Revenge
RoaringRampageOfRevenge.def: A character is pushed so far over the edge and goes completely ballistic on those that hurt them.

RobbingTheMobBank.name: Robbing the Mob Bank
RobbingTheMobBank.def: A thief steals from another criminal, who tries to get the thief caught.

Robinsonade.name: Robinsonade
Robinsonade.def: The plot is about one or more characters living stranded away from civilization and having to live off the land.

RogueJuror.name: Rogue Juror
RogueJuror.def: One juror's opinion goes against the others', and it's up to them to change their minds.

RoommateDrama.name: Roommate Drama
RoommateDrama.def: Characters share a room or house, and things go wrong.

RunForTheBorder.name: Run for the Border
RunForTheBorder.def: A criminal tries to escape the law by fleeing to another country.

SafetyWorst.name: Safety Worst
SafetyWorst.def: Someone takes safety precautions to such an extent that they're impractical and/or no fun.

SatchelSwitcheroo.name: Satchel Switcheroo
SatchelSwitcheroo.def: Two characters who own the same kind briefcase or any other container get it mixed up with one another.

SaveOurStudents.name: Save Our Students
SaveOurStudents.def: A teacher strives to improve the futures of students who attend a horrible school.

SaveOurTeam.name: Save Our Team
SaveOurTeam.def: A struggling sports team is turned around by a new coach to win a high-stakes grudge match.

SaveThePrincess.name: Save the Princess
SaveThePrincess.def: An Excuse Plot for rescuing a princess that has been kidnapped.

SavingChristmas.name: Saving Christmas
SavingChristmas.def: Someone has to prevent Christmas from being ruined for everyone who celebrates the holiday.

SavingTheOrphanage.name: Saving the Orphanage
SavingTheOrphanage.def: The hero has to stop a heartless business exec who wants to destroy a local Orphanage of Love .

SavingTheWorld.name: Saving the World
SavingTheWorld.def: The heroes try to save the world's population from the villains evil plan.

ScareDare.name: Scare Dare
ScareDare.def: A childhood dare consisting of waltzing into spookiness.

ScarecrowSolution.name: Scarecrow Solution
ScarecrowSolution.def: When a character can't fight something, they build something to scare it away.

ScarpiaUltimatum.name: Scarpia Ultimatum
ScarpiaUltimatum.def: Someone is blackmailed into having sex with a person who threatens to hurt someone they care about if they refuse.

ScarySurpriseParty.name: Scary Surprise Party
ScarySurpriseParty.def: Something nasty happens to a character (kidnapped, in danger) but it turns out to be a surprise party.

ScavengerHunt.name: Scavenger Hunt
ScavengerHunt.def: Characters play a game where they find a list of items before a set deadline.

SchoolForScheming.name: School for Scheming
SchoolForScheming.def: A school that is used as a cover for an elaborate plot-centric scheme.

SchrodingersButterfly.name: Schrödinger's Butterfly
SchrodingersButterfly.def: Stories where it's never completely clear whether everything is real or not.

ScienceIsUseless.name: Science Is Useless
ScienceIsUseless.def: When science isn't bad or wrong , it just simply isn't helpful.

ScoobyDooHoax.name: "Scooby-Doo" Hoax
ScoobyDooHoax.def: A monster is revealed to actually be a disguised criminal pretending to be one.

ScrewTheRulesImDoingWhatsRight.name: Screw the Rules, I'm Doing What's Right!
ScrewTheRulesImDoingWhatsRight.def: Deliberately defying rules because they go against doing what is clearly the right thing.

SeaAping.name: Sea Aping
SeaAping.def: A child character buying a fictional counterpart of sea-monkeys, expecting the pets to have a civilization like they're advertised to.

SealTheBreach.name: Seal the Breach
SealTheBreach.def: Characters are at or travel to a place that has a breach, whether it is a hole in a dam or a gateway to Hell.

SeasonFinale.name: Season Finale
SeasonFinale.def: The final episode of the show's season.

SecretDiary.name: Secret Diary
SecretDiary.def: One character finds another character's secret diary and may be tempted to read it.

TheSecretLifeOfNonhumans.name: The Secret Life of Nonhumans
TheSecretLifeOfNonhumans.def: Animals or even inanimate objects are secretly sentient and having their own society and lives unbeknown to humans.

SecretPetPlot.name: Secret Pet Plot
SecretPetPlot.def: A character adopts a pet and tries to hide it.

SecretRelationship.name: Secret Relationship
SecretRelationship.def: Characters are in a relationship that they don't want their friends and family to know about.

SelectiveEnforcement.name: Selective Enforcement
SelectiveEnforcement.def: A rule is only enforced at random, which can result in people not being punished for breaking it when they really should be and harshly punishing offenders who otherwise didn't do anything wrong.

SendInTheSearchTeam.name: Send in the Search Team
SendInTheSearchTeam.def: Something has gone wrong at an unknown location, and a seach party is gathered to find out what happened.

SeparatedAtBirth.name: Separated at Birth
SeparatedAtBirth.def: Two normally unrelated characters are revealed to be twin siblings raised apart from each other.

SerialKiller.name: Serial Killer
SerialKiller.def: There's a murderer on the loose, and people are dying one by one. Can the heroes stop the killer before they strike again?

SettlingTheFrontier.name: Settling the Frontier
SettlingTheFrontier.def: Standard Western plot involving people establishing a colony or settlement in a previously unknown land.

TheSevenWesternPlots.name: The Seven Western Plots
TheSevenWesternPlots.def: Westerns often revolve around stories involving railroads, ranches, empire building, cavalry and Indians, revenge, outlaws and lawmen.

SexAsRiteOfPassage.name: Sex as Rite-of-Passage
SexAsRiteOfPassage.def: Characters set out to get themselves laid.

SexEqualsLove.name: Sex Equals Love
SexEqualsLove.def: Characters who are in a sexual relationship but not in love will fall in love eventually.

SexForServices.name: Sex for Services
SexForServices.def: Trading sexual favors for non-sexual favors.

SexyManInstantHarem.name: Sexy Man, Instant Harem
SexyManInstantHarem.def: A man who is The Casanova will often attract women.

ShaggyDogStory.name: "Shaggy Dog" Story
ShaggyDogStory.def: A story's buildup has no payoff.

TheShowMustGoOn.name: The Show Must Go On
TheShowMustGoOn.def: No matter what problems occur during a live performance, the characters do what they can to keep the show going.

ShowWithinAShow.name: Show Within a Show
ShowWithinAShow.def: A work of fiction that exists within the work of fiction.

SidekickGlassCeiling.name: Sidekick Glass Ceiling
SidekickGlassCeiling.def: The sidekick can never permanently become stronger than the hero.

TheSiege.name: The Siege
TheSiege.def: The good guys must hold off an overwhelming enemy threat against impossible odds.

ASimplePlan.name: A Simple Plan
ASimplePlan.def: The characters come up with an easy straightforward plan, only for it to fall apart.

SinkOrSwimFatherhood.name: Sink or Swim Fatherhood
SinkOrSwimFatherhood.def: A character unexpectedly becomes a parent and must learn on the job.

SinkingShipScenario.name: Sinking Ship Scenario
SinkingShipScenario.def: Catastrophic damage to a large vehicle forces the characters to struggle to survive.

SkippingSchool.name: Skipping School
SkippingSchool.def: A student decides not to go to school and goes off to do something else instead.

SleepLearning.name: Sleep Learning
SleepLearning.def: Someone tries to learn information in their sleep.

SlowAndSteadyWinsTheRace.name: Slow and Steady Wins the Race
SlowAndSteadyWinsTheRace.def: A character loses a race for most of the story, but wins at the end

SlumberPartyPloy.name: Slumber Party Ploy
SlumberPartyPloy.def: In order to do something or go somewhere they were prohibited from, kids lie to their parents that they are staying over at each others' houses.

SnipeHunt.name: Snipe Hunt
SnipeHunt.def: A character is tricked into searching for a nonexistent thing.

SnowballingThreat.name: Snowballing Threat
SnowballingThreat.def: Must stop something urgently before it becomes too powerful.

SnowedIn.name: Snowed-In
SnowedIn.def: Snow is packed around your building, vehicle, etc., and you are stuck for a while.

TheSoCalledCoward.name: The So-Called Coward
TheSoCalledCoward.def: A character is passive and non-violent, making them branded a coward by everyone, only for something to happen that proves otherwise.

SoNearYetSoFar.name: So Near, Yet So Far
SoNearYetSoFar.def: You're already at your destination, but can't do what you need to.

SorcerersApprenticePlot.name: Sorcerer's Apprentice Plot
SorcerersApprenticePlot.def: A young ward's attempts to be like his boss becomes too much for him to handle.

SouvenirLand.name: Souvenir Land
SouvenirLand.def: A disappointing, cheap Theme Parks that tries (and fails) to ride on the coattails of A-list parks like Disneyland .

SpeedDating.name: Speed Dating
SpeedDating.def: A character tries speed dating in order to meet someone.

SpellingBee.name: Spelling Bee
SpellingBee.def: A competition where the characters try to spell words.

SplitAndReunion.name: Split and Reunion
SplitAndReunion.def: A Split Personality gets separated. When it reunites, issues are resolved an teamwork has improved.

SplitTimelinesPlot.name: Split Timelines Plot
SplitTimelinesPlot.def: A story that switches between Alternate Timelines after depicting a single diverging event.

SpotTheImpostor.name: Spot the Impostor
SpotTheImpostor.def: One character is seen with their impersonator, resulting in their friends having to figure out which is which.

StartMyOwn.name: Start My Own
StartMyOwn.def: A character is disgruntled with the way a certain group is run, so they decide to start their own.

StartOfDarkness.name: Start of Darkness
StartOfDarkness.def: The moment in a villain's life where they started to become evil.

StockEvilOverlordTactics.name: Stock Evil Overlord Tactics
StockEvilOverlordTactics.def: Common evil plans that villains come up with.

StoneSoup.name: Stone Soup
StoneSoup.def: Manipulating others via feigned eccentric behavior.

StormInATeacup.name: Storm in a Teacup
StormInATeacup.def: Desperately trying to get a task done well/in time. Plot Twist : It wasn't necessary.

StorybookEpisode.name: Storybook Episode
StorybookEpisode.def: The characters are cast as fairy tale archetypes.

StrangerInAStrangeSchool.name: Stranger in a Strange School
StrangerInAStrangeSchool.def: An Ordinary High-School Student who winds up attending an Extranormal Institute .

StrangersOnATrainPlotMurder.name: "Strangers on a Train"-Plot Murder
StrangersOnATrainPlotMurder.def: Two people make a deal to commit each other's heinous crime/difficult task.

StumbledIntoThePlot.name: Stumbled Into the Plot
StumbledIntoThePlot.def: The protagonist is the one who finds the Inciting Incident instead of being chosen or summoned .

StumblingUponTheLostWizard.name: Stumbling Upon the Lost Wizard
StumblingUponTheLostWizard.def: The Protagonist(s) accidentally find a character of great importance when they become lost themselves.

SubvertedSuspicionAesop.name: Subverted Suspicion Aesop
SubvertedSuspicionAesop.def: It looks like the person who assumed the reformed guy hasn't changed was just being paranoid... But it turns out that they were right to question the villain claiming to be good.

SuccessionCrisis.name: Succession Crisis
SuccessionCrisis.def: The king dies and no one knows who will succeed him.

SuddenIntelligence.name: Sudden Intelligence
SuddenIntelligence.def: A character is abruptly given an IQ boost.

SuicideMission.name: Suicide Mission
SuicideMission.def: A mission will almost certainly end in death for whoever accepts it.

SummonEverymanHero.name: Summon Everyman Hero
SummonEverymanHero.def: An average person is brought into another for a wacky adventure.

SuperPowersForADay.name: Superpowers for a Day
SuperPowersForADay.def: A normal person temporarily gains special powers.

SuperheroEpisode.name: Superhero Episode
SuperheroEpisode.def: An episode where everyone becomes superheroes.

SuperheroOrigin.name: Superhero Origin
SuperheroOrigin.def: The story of how a superhero gained their powers and decided to fight crime.

SuspicionAesop.name: Suspicion Aesop
SuspicionAesop.def: The protagonist suspects someone else is up to no good, only to be proven wrong, and learn a lesson about not jumping to conclusions.

SwearWordPlot.name: Swear Word Plot
SwearWordPlot.def: Characters start swearing excessively and get in trouble for it.

TagAlongActor.name: Tag-Along Actor
TagAlongActor.def: An actor researches the role of a special profession by shadowing their real life counterpart.

TagTeamSuicide.name: Tag Team Suicide
TagTeamSuicide.def: Two people kill themselves because a failure to communicate causes them both to think the other has died.

TakingOverHeaven.name: Taking Over Heaven
TakingOverHeaven.def: Attacking Heaven and taking charge of it.

TakingOverTheTown.name: Taking Over the Town
TakingOverTheTown.def: The villains take over a town and steal from it.

TalentContest.name: Talent Contest
TalentContest.def: Characters participate in an amateur talent contest.

TalkingYourWayOut.name: Talking Your Way Out
TalkingYourWayOut.def: The hero is caught by the villains, but manages to use smooth talking to get away.

TalkShowAppearance.name: Talk Show Appearance
TalkShowAppearance.def: Protagonist(s) go on a talk show to resolve their issues, become famous or even to make a point. It never ends well.

TallTale.name: Tall Tale
TallTale.def: A story told so many times it now makes no sense at all.

TheTaxi.name: The Taxi
TheTaxi.def: A taxi cab is used as a mode of transportation for characters.

TeacherStudentRomance.name: Teacher/Student Romance
TeacherStudentRomance.def: A student and a teacher get into a romantic or sexual relationship. Highly inadvisable in Real Life .

TeachHimAnger.name: Teach Him Anger
TeachHimAnger.def: A character who is normally the Nice Guy is taught by their friends to be more assertive.

TechnicianVersusPerformer.name: Technician Versus Performer
TechnicianVersusPerformer.def: Two characters contrast each other because one is all about being accurate and the other just wants to have fun.

TenLittleMurderVictims.name: Ten Little Murder Victims
TenLittleMurderVictims.def: A group of people are stuck somewhere. One of them is a killer, the rest are potential victims.

TheirFirstTime.name: Their First Time
TheirFirstTime.def: The first time two people had sex in their entire lives.

TheresNoPlaceLikeHome.name: There's No Place Like Home
TheresNoPlaceLikeHome.def: A character's main goal is to go back home.

ThisLooksLikeAJobForAquaman.name: This Looks Like a Job for Aquaman!
ThisLooksLikeAJobForAquaman.def: A character with not-so-useful powers is put in a situation where they'd actually be helpful.

ThrillerOnTheExpress.name: Thriller on the Express
ThrillerOnTheExpress.def: A crime/espionage/murder mystery story centered around a moving train setting.

ThroughTheEyesOfMadness.name: Through the Eyes of Madness
ThroughTheEyesOfMadness.def: Crazy people see the world differently from normal people.

TimeToMove.name: Time to Move
TimeToMove.def: The man of the house decides it's time to move and the rest of the family attempts to stop this.

TimeTravelEscape.name: Time Travel Escape
TimeTravelEscape.def: Saving a dead person via time travel.

TimeTravelRomance.name: Time-Travel Romance
TimeTravelRomance.def: Romance between people from different time periods.

TitanomachyRoundTwo.name: Titanomachy, Round Two
TitanomachyRoundTwo.def: Someone's trying to free the Titans of Greek Mythology to take out the Gods.

ToHellAndBack.name: To Hell and Back
ToHellAndBack.def: Part of the hero's mission involves entering Hell or a similar place.

Tontine.name: Tontine
Tontine.def: A group of people make an agreement that the valuables they've found will go to the last surviving member of the group.

TooManyCooksSpoilTheSoup.name: Too Many Cooks Spoil the Soup
TooManyCooksSpoilTheSoup.def: Things will end in disaster if a project has too many people involved in working on it.

TooSmartForStrangers.name: Too Smart for Strangers
TooSmartForStrangers.def: The story is supposed to prevent children being kidnapped or molested by warning them about strangers.

TournamentArc.name: Tournament Arc
TournamentArc.def: A plot arc consisting of characters fighting each other in a competition.

TrainJob.name: Train Job
TrainJob.def: Boarding a train in order to steal from it.

TrainingAccident.name: Training "Accident"
TrainingAccident.def: A character undergoes special training only for something to go horrible wrong .

TrainingThePeacefulVillagers.name: Training the Peaceful Villagers
TrainingThePeacefulVillagers.def: The Hero trains a local village to fight back against an advancing army.

TrainingThePet.name: Training the Pet
TrainingThePet.def: A plot revolving someone trying to train a naughty pet.

TheTrapParents.name: The Trap Parents
TheTrapParents.def: An orphan gains some parents that don't want them to hang around their friends.

TrappedInThePast.name: Trapped in the Past
TrappedInThePast.def: Someone accidentally ends up in the past without knowing how to come back.

TrappedInTVLand.name: Trapped in TV Land
TrappedInTVLand.def: Someone gets trapped inside a work of fiction.

TrappedWithMonsterPlot.name: Trapped-with-Monster Plot
TrappedWithMonsterPlot.def: Characters are in a Closed Circle with something hunting them.

TreasureMap.name: Treasure Map
TreasureMap.def: A map leading to hidden treasure.

TrendAesop.name: Trend Aesop
TrendAesop.def: A character learns a lesson about trying to fit in with the crowd.

TrickedIntoSigning.name: Tricked into Signing
TrickedIntoSigning.def: A character is tricked into signing an important document.

TroubleFollowsYouHome.name: Trouble Follows You Home
TroubleFollowsYouHome.def: A character makes it home after escaping trouble, only to find trouble waiting for them there.

TroubleFromThePast.name: Trouble from the Past
TroubleFromThePast.def: A plot where future generations have to deal with the mess made by their civilization in the past.

TroublemakingNewPet.name: Troublemaking New Pet
TroublemakingNewPet.def: New pet is up to no good, blames their actions on the older.

ATrueStoryInMyUniverse.name: A True Story in My Universe
ATrueStoryInMyUniverse.def: The events of a work are Based on a True Story , or similar, within the story itself .

TrumanShowPlot.name: "Truman Show" Plot
TrumanShowPlot.def: Someone discovers that their life was part of a film or television show without their knowledge.

TurnInYourBadge.name: Turn in Your Badge
TurnInYourBadge.def: A cop who has stepped over the line is ordered to turn in their badge and gun.

TurnedAgainstTheirMasters.name: Turned Against Their Masters
TurnedAgainstTheirMasters.def: Artificially derived beings turn against their creators.

TwelfthNightAdventure.name: Twelfth Night Adventure
TwelfthNightAdventure.def: A character becomes a Wholesome Crossdresser to integrate himself/herself into the setting.

TwinSwitch.name: Twin Switch
TwinSwitch.def: Twins swap roles with each other, such as with a Two-Timer Date . Hilarity Ensues if they are Polar Opposite Twins .

TwoTimerDate.name: Two-Timer Date
TwoTimerDate.def: A character schedules dates with two different people at the same time.

UnbelievableSourcePlot.name: Unbelievable Source Plot
UnbelievableSourcePlot.def: A plot where the protagonist relies on a supernatural source of information to solve crimes.

UndercoverAsLovers.name: Undercover as Lovers
UndercoverAsLovers.def: Two spies pose as lovers as they go undercover.

UniqueMomentRuined.name: Unique Moment Ruined
UniqueMomentRuined.def: A highly anticipated moment or event is ruined by something.

UnlockingTheTalent.name: Unlocking the Talent
UnlockingTheTalent.def: A character has a skill that they never use and have to learn to use it to their advantage.

UnsettlingGenderReveal.name: Unsettling Gender-Reveal
UnsettlingGenderReveal.def: Someone is disturbed by the revelation that a woman is actually a man in drag.

UntrustingCommunity.name: Untrusting Community
UntrustingCommunity.def: A whole town full of people who don't like you.

UnwantedGiftPlot.name: Unwanted Gift Plot
UnwantedGiftPlot.def: A character is given a gift they don't like, and now have to pretend they like it to not hurt the giver's feelings.

UnwantedGlassesPlot.name: Unwanted Glasses Plot
UnwantedGlassesPlot.def: A character discovers they need glasses, but refuses to wear them because they look uncool.

UnwantedHealing.name: Unwanted Healing
UnwantedHealing.def: A character has a terrible illness, but refuses to accept treatment for it.

UnwantedRescue.name: Unwanted Rescue
UnwantedRescue.def: The Hero saves someone in trouble only to learn that they didn't want to be rescued.

UnwantedRevival.name: Unwanted Revival
UnwantedRevival.def: A resurrected person isn't happy that they've been brought back to life.

UnwittingTestSubject.name: Unwitting Test Subject
UnwittingTestSubject.def: A thinking subject (human, sapient animal, ect.) is part of a scientific experiment without their knowledge or consent.

UtopiaJustifiesTheMeans.name: Utopia Justifies the Means
UtopiaJustifiesTheMeans.def: A situation where the goal of the Big Bad is the creation of a better world for everyone as a whole, no matter what the cost.

VampireRefugee.name: Vampire Refugee
VampireRefugee.def: Someone turned by a vampire decides to find and kill the vampire that bit them to reverse the transformation.

VanishingVillage.name: Vanishing Village
VanishingVillage.def: A location that only appears or is accessible for certain periods of time.

VerySpecialEpisode.name: Very Special Episode
VerySpecialEpisode.def: An episode dedicating to dealing with a serious subject not usually brought up in other shows.

VignetteEpisode.name: Vignette Episode
VignetteEpisode.def: An episode composed of several vignettes.

VillainBeatingArtifact.name: Villain-Beating Artifact
VillainBeatingArtifact.def: The villain is invincible to everything but a specific artifact.

VillainEpisode.name: Villain Episode
VillainEpisode.def: An episode where the bad guy is the protagonist instead of the hero.

VisionsOfAnotherSelf.name: Visions of Another Self
VisionsOfAnotherSelf.def: The same actors play different characters in the past and future vision scenes.

VisitByDivorcedDad.name: Visit by Divorced Dad
VisitByDivorcedDad.def: A divorced father visits his children.

WakeUpCall.name: Wake-Up Call
WakeUpCall.def: Something occurs that forces a character to develop out of complacency, get their act together, learn a lesson, or some combination thereof.

WakeUpGoToSchoolSaveTheWorld.name: Wake Up, Go to School, Save the World
WakeUpGoToSchoolSaveTheWorld.def: A Kid Hero has to juggle heroics and their personal life.

WarComesHome.name: War Comes Home
WarComesHome.def: When a war spreads to the hero's homeland, making it personal.

WarForFunAndProfit.name: War for Fun and Profit
WarForFunAndProfit.def: Instigating a war for one's own material benefit.

WarFromAnotherWorld.name: War from Another World
WarFromAnotherWorld.def: When a world and its inhabitants unwillingly gets drawn into a war from elsewhere.

WasTooHardOnHim.name: Was Too Hard on Him
WasTooHardOnHim.def: A character feels sad and guilty over scolding or harshly punishing someone.

WaybackTrip.name: Wayback Trip
WaybackTrip.def: The protagonist/s have to fix a change in history but the change has happened for seemingly no reason.

WeNeedToGetProof.name: We Need to Get Proof
WeNeedToGetProof.def: The heroes discover the bad guy is up to no good, but need to find a way for others to believe them.

WeWantOurIdiotBack.name: We Want Our Idiot Back!
WeWantOurIdiotBack.def: A formerly idiotic character becomes smart, and their peers want to change them back for one reason or another.

WeWantOurJerkBack.name: We Want Our Jerk Back!
WeWantOurJerkBack.def: A mean character becomes nicer or leaves, resulting in everyone else deciding that things were better when the guy was still around or still a jerk.

WeWouldHaveToldYouBut.name: We Would Have Told You, But...
WeWouldHaveToldYouBut.def: A character has to be kept in the dark about something in order for the plan to work out.

WellIntentionedReplacement.name: Well-Intentioned Replacement
WellIntentionedReplacement.def: Replacing an important artifact after it has been destroyed or lost.

WhatCouldPossiblyGoWrong.name: What Could Possibly Go Wrong?
WhatCouldPossiblyGoWrong.def: The dreaded words that, when spoken, will certainly lead to disaster.

WhatsInsidePlot.name: "What's Inside?" Plot
WhatsInsidePlot.def: Characters try to figure out what is hidden inside a locked box or closet.

WhoWillTakeTheKids.name: Who Will Take The Kids?
WhoWillTakeTheKids.def: Parents wonder who would look after the kids if something bad happened.

WhodunnitToMe.name: Whodunnit to Me?
WhodunnitToMe.def: Someone who survives or is resurrected after an attempt to do them in tries to figure out who their murderer or would-be murderer was.

WholeEpisodeFlashback.name: Whole Episode Flashback
WholeEpisodeFlashback.def: Episode consisting mainly of one long flashback to past events.

WholePlotReference.name: Whole-Plot Reference
WholePlotReference.def: An entire episode copies the plot of a well-known story.

WitchHunt.name: Witch Hunt
WitchHunt.def: A search, often misguided, for a witch hidden among the community.

WorkingTheSameCase.name: Working the Same Case
WorkingTheSameCase.def: Two teams who are investigating the same case.

WorkplaceHorror.name: Workplace Horror
WorkplaceHorror.def: A setting where unexpected horrors appear while trying do to a mundane job.

WorldLimitedToThePlot.name: World Limited to the Plot
WorldLimitedToThePlot.def: A story that has no context in its setting.

WorldTour.name: World Tour
WorldTour.def: The characters travel to well-known places around the world.

WoundedGazelleGambit.name: Wounded Gazelle Gambit
WoundedGazelleGambit.def: Manipulating people by pretending to be injured.

WoundedGazelleWarcry.name: Wounded Gazelle Warcry
WoundedGazelleWarcry.def: The weakest combatant rushes in harm's way to motivate the others into action.

WrongTimeTravelSavvy.name: Wrong Time-Travel Savvy
WrongTimeTravelSavvy.def: Someone mistakenly thinks they know how time travel works.

XMustNotWin.name: X Must Not Win
XMustNotWin.def: Wanting to avoid letting a particular character be victorious provides fuel for the other character's persistence in fighting against them.

XanatosGambit.name: Xanatos Gambit
XanatosGambit.def: A plan for which all foreseeable outcomes benefit the creator — including ones that superficially appear to be failure.

YearningForANemesis.name: Yearning for a Nemesis
YearningForANemesis.def: A character desires to find a nemesis.

YellowBrickRoad.name: Yellow Brick Road
YellowBrickRoad.def: The pathway a character has to travel along to get to their ultimate goal.

YouAlreadyChangedThePast.name: You Already Changed the Past
YouAlreadyChangedThePast.def: Someone attempts to prevent an atrocity from happening in the past, only to find in the end that the atrocity wouldn't have happened in the first place if they didn't go back in time to try and prevent it.

YouCanKeepHer.name: You Can Keep Her!
YouCanKeepHer.def: A character is contacted by some kidnappers who are holding someone they should care about for ransom, but the character doesn't care.

YouGoGirl.name: You Go, Girl!
YouGoGirl.def: A girl proves that she's as good as the boys in athletics.

YouHaveWaitedLongEnough.name: You Have Waited Long Enough
YouHaveWaitedLongEnough.def: A character is forced to marry someone else when the one they love doesn't come right back to them.

YouKnowWhatYouDid.name: You Know What You Did
YouKnowWhatYouDid.def: A character assumes the worst about someone without bothering to confirm it.

YouWakeUpInARoom.name: You Wake Up in a Room
YouWakeUpInARoom.def: A character wakes up in an unfamiliar place at the beginning of the story.

YouWakeUpOnABeach.name: You Wake Up on a Beach
YouWakeUpOnABeach.def: Someone wakes up on the beach with no recollection of how they got there.

YoyoPlotPoint.name: Yo-Yo Plot Point
YoyoPlotPoint.def: A premise-changing plot point is resolved and unresolved several times over the course of the work.

ZanyScheme.name: Zany Scheme
ZanyScheme.def: One or more characters tries to achieve some end — usually extricating themselves from trouble — by some kind of elaborate, unlikely plan.

ZanySchemeChicken.name: Zany Scheme Chicken
ZanySchemeChicken.def: An escalating war of zany schemes, which grow progressively more absurd.

AlienAmongUs.name: Alien Among Us
AlienAmongUs.def: An alien living with a bunch of humans and trying to keep their alienness secret.

BlitheSpirit.name: Blithe Spirit
BlitheSpirit.def: An unusual stranger who goes to a straight-laced land and teaches others to think differently about themselves.

ChangelingFantasy.name: Changeling Fantasy
ChangelingFantasy.def: A character's real parents are much more exciting than their other ones.

ComingOfAgeStory.name: Coming of Age Story
ComingOfAgeStory.def: A child or adolescent learns to be more mature.

FishOutOfWater.name: Fish Out of Water
FishOutOfWater.def: A character is placed in a situation completely unfamiliar to them.

GottaCatchEmAll.name: Gotta Catch 'Em All
GottaCatchEmAll.def: A character wants to pursue a collection.

GottaKillThemAll.name: Gotta Kill Them All
GottaKillThemAll.def: A character wants to kill everyone on their list.

LimelightSeries.name: Limelight Series
LimelightSeries.def: A series that stars old or obscure characters from the previous series.

RagsToRiches.name: Rags to Riches
RagsToRiches.def: A character goes from being poor or living modestly to being wealthy and successful.

RoleSwapPlot.name: Role Swap Plot
RoleSwapPlot.def: An episode switches the roles of certain characters.

SetRightWhatOnceWentWrong.name: Set Right What Once Went Wrong
SetRightWhatOnceWentWrong.def: Altering the past to prevent bad things from ever occurring.

SternChase.name: Stern Chase
SternChase.def: The protagonist is being pursued and must stay in motion.

SystematicVillainTakedown.name: Systematic Villain Takedown
SystematicVillainTakedown.def: A group of villains is taken down one by one during the course of an arc or a story.

TakeYourChildToWorkDayPlot.name: "Take Your Child to Work Day" Plot
TakeYourChildToWorkDayPlot.def: An episode revolving around a parent taking their child to work. Hijinks usually ensue.

ThereCanBeOnlyOne.name: There Can Be Only One
ThereCanBeOnlyOne.def: A group of characters have to kill each other until only one remains.

ToBeAMaster.name: To Be a Master
ToBeAMaster.def: The protagonist's main goal is to be the very best, like no one ever was .

VictoriousLoser.name: Victorious Loser
VictoriousLoser.def: The protagonist loses everything around him/her, but the protagonist's spirit isn't broken and achieves his/her goal.

VictoryIsBoring.name: Victory Is Boring
VictoryIsBoring.def: Achieving one's goal has the downside of no longer having the fun of trying to achieve it.

VillainousLegacy.name: Villainous Legacy
VillainousLegacy.def: The villain has inspired evil long after they passed away.

WalkingTheEarth.name: Walking the Earth
WalkingTheEarth.def: A character travels the earth, never returning home.

WarArc.name: War Arc
WarArc.def: A Story Arc that concerns two or more large-scale factions (city-sized at least) in conflict with one another.

WaterSourceTampering.name: Water Source Tampering
WaterSourceTampering.def: Villains tamper with the water supply.

WhiteMansBurden.name: White Man's Burden
WhiteMansBurden.def: A well-to-do white character selflessly works to help an unfortunate person of color.

WithholdingTheCure.name: Withholding the Cure
WithholdingTheCure.def: Someone prevents the cure for a disease from getting to the sick people for selfish reasons.

WrongTurnAtAlbuquerque.name: Wrong Turn at Albuquerque
WrongTurnAtAlbuquerque.def: A single wrong turn lands the traveler in a place far from their original goal.

WunzaPlot.name: Wunza Plot
WunzaPlot.def: A plot with two characters who are very different and team up to accomplish a goal.

YouAreTheNewTrend.name: You Are the New Trend
YouAreTheNewTrend.def: A character's distinctive look or mannerisms becomes the model for the latest hot trend.

YoungestChildWins.name: Youngest Child Wins
YoungestChildWins.def: The youngest sibling has the best luck in life.

YouthIsWastedOnTheDumb.name: Youth Is Wasted on the Dumb
YouthIsWastedOnTheDumb.def: Children and teenagers can be pretty stupid.

ZombieApocalypse.name: Zombie Apocalypse
ZombieApocalypse.def: The world ends via being overrun by the undead.

ActionPrologue.name: Action Prologue
ActionPrologue.def: Something exciting happens before the story begins.

AfterTheEnd.name: After the End
AfterTheEnd.def: The story takes place in an apocalyptic setting.

AweInspiringDinosaurShot.name: Awe-Inspiring Dinosaur Shot
AweInspiringDinosaurShot.def: A work focusing on dinosaurs is introduced by showing how grand and epic these prehistoric animals were during their time, with specific camera shots being used to underscore the effect.

BatmanColdOpen.name: Batman Cold Open
BatmanColdOpen.def: The episode begins with the heroes dealing with a threat that isn't connected to the main episode's plot.

BigFirstChoice.name: Big First Choice
BigFirstChoice.def: An early decision has massive impact on the entire rest of the story.

BirthdayBeginning.name: Birthday Beginning
BirthdayBeginning.def: The story begins with the announcement that it's the main character's birthday, and often it's the day they reach adulthood.

BizarroBeginning.name: Bizarro Beginning
BizarroBeginning.def: The opening of a story makes little to no sense compared to the rest of it.

BlitzEvacuees.name: Blitz Evacuees
BlitzEvacuees.def: A child protagonist is evacuated from a city under attack and is sent to live in the country.

BloodbathVillainOrigin.name: Bloodbath Villain Origin
BloodbathVillainOrigin.def: A villain's Start of Darkness is them committing a mass murder.

Bookends.name: Bookends
Bookends.def: The beginning and ending of a story occur under similar circumstances and are tied together somehow.

BoyMeetsGirl.name: Boy Meets Girl
BoyMeetsGirl.def: A boy and a girl meet each other, lose each other, then find each other again.

BurningBeginning.name: Burning Beginning
BurningBeginning.def: Beginning a work by depicting fire.

CluelessPhlebotinumExposure.name: Clueless Phlebotinum Exposure
CluelessPhlebotinumExposure.def: The story begins with a curious or foolish character interfering with a weird substance.

DangerRoomColdOpen.name: Danger Room Cold Open
DangerRoomColdOpen.def: The episode starts with the characters in a combat training room.

DayInTheLifeTitles.name: "Day in the Life" Titles
DayInTheLifeTitles.def: The title sequence shows the main characters going out and about in their everyday lives.

DebutQueue.name: Debut Queue
DebutQueue.def: The main characters are gradually brought together by introducing each cast member one at a time across the following episodes.

DecoyProtagonist.name: Decoy Protagonist
DecoyProtagonist.def: The beginning shows a character who's treated as the story's protagonist, but is immediately killed off or otherwise removed from the story as the real main character shows up.

DistantPrologue.name: Distant Prologue
DistantPrologue.def: A short introduction scene at the start of the story that takes place a long time before the main plot happens.

DoomedHometown.name: Doomed Hometown
DoomedHometown.def: The destruction of the hero's hometown is what stirs them into the adventure.

DramaticChaseOpening.name: Dramatic Chase Opening
DramaticChaseOpening.def: The story begins with a dramatic chase scene.

DreamIntro.name: Dream Intro
DreamIntro.def: The story begins with a character's dream sequence.

DroppedAfterThePilot.name: Dropped After the Pilot
DroppedAfterThePilot.def: A character featured in the first episode is absent for the rest of the series.

EarlyBirdCameo.name: Early-Bird Cameo
EarlyBirdCameo.def: A character makes a brief appearance before being properly introduced.

EasingIntoTheAdventure.name: Easing into the Adventure
EasingIntoTheAdventure.def: A prologue that covers the protagonist's ordinary life before going on the adventure.

EnthusiasticNewbieTeacher.name: Enthusiastic Newbie Teacher
EnthusiasticNewbieTeacher.def: A friendly teacher who is just out of schooling.

EntryPoint.name: Entry Point
EntryPoint.def: The player's way into an Alternate Reality Game .

EstablishingCharacterMoment.name: Establishing Character Moment
EstablishingCharacterMoment.def: The first thing a character says or does that makes it clear the kind of person they are.

EstablishingSeriesMoment.name: Establishing Series Moment
EstablishingSeriesMoment.def: The one moment that represents what the whole series will be about.

FakeActionPrologue.name: Fake Action Prologue
FakeActionPrologue.def: The story starts out with what appears to be an action scene, but it turns out to be fake.

FakeFilmIntro.name: Fake Film Intro
FakeFilmIntro.def: Beginning a story with a Show Within a Show or some other fictional footage.

FakeOutOpening.name: Fake-Out Opening
FakeOutOpening.def: The first scene of a movie that's different from the rest of the film.

FallInAngel.name: Fall-in Angel
FallInAngel.def: A girl falling from the sky is what kickstarts the plot.

FallingIntoThePlot.name: Falling into the Plot
FallingIntoThePlot.def: The protagonist falls from the sky at the start of a work.

FirstEpisodeResurrection.name: First-Episode Resurrection
FirstEpisodeResurrection.def: The hero dies and is brought back to life at the beginning of the story.

FirstEpisodeTwist.name: First-Episode Twist
FirstEpisodeTwist.def: A plot twist is revealed very early on in the story.

FiveEpisodePilot.name: Five-Episode Pilot
FiveEpisodePilot.def: A television series begins with a Multi-Part Episode .

ForegoneConclusion.name: Foregone Conclusion
ForegoneConclusion.def: The story begins by letting the audience know how it'll end.

ForGreatJustice.name: For Great Justice
ForGreatJustice.def: The motive or reason is stated in the opening.

FramingDevice.name: Framing Device
FramingDevice.def: A story being told in the main plot of a work. Forgotten Framing Device : The story within another story is missing the latter half of its outer frame.

GoodMorningCrono.name: Good Morning, Crono
GoodMorningCrono.def: The story begins with the main character being woken up.

HappyEndingOverride.name: Happy Ending Override
HappyEndingOverride.def: A sequel starts by undoing the happy ending of a previous installment.

AHeroIsBorn.name: A Hero Is Born
AHeroIsBorn.def: The story begins with the hero's birth or infancy.

HiddenFirstActParallel.name: Hidden First Act Parallel
HiddenFirstActParallel.def: A story element near the beginning of a story contains a parallel to its framing device or a later plot point.

HorrifyingIntroCalmFirstChapter.name: Horrifying Intro, Calm First Chapter
HorrifyingIntroCalmFirstChapter.def: A story begins with a terrifying, horror-genre-coded prologue, only to calm down until later.

HowWeGotHere.name: How We Got Here
HowWeGotHere.def: The story begins partway through the plot and then starts to explain how things got to that point.

TheIdolsBlessing.name: The Idol's Blessing
TheIdolsBlessing.def: Incompetent main character receives a boon from their idol, thus beginning their journey.

IFoundYouLikeThis.name: I Found You Like This
IFoundYouLikeThis.def: A character who has passed out from injury wakes up in the care of someone treating them.

IncitingIncident.name: Inciting Incident
IncitingIncident.def: An event that sets the plot in motion.

IntroductoryOpeningCredits.name: Introductory Opening Credits
IntroductoryOpeningCredits.def: Credits in a show's opening sequence that display the characters with their names beside them.

IntroOnlyPointOfView.name: Intro-Only Point of View
IntroOnlyPointOfView.def: The opening of a story that is told from a character's point of view.

ItBeganWithATwistOfFate.name: It Began with a Twist of Fate
ItBeganWithATwistOfFate.def: The protagonist's involvement in a story's events results from a simple decision.

ItWasADarkAndStormyNight.name: It Was a Dark and Stormy Night
ItWasADarkAndStormyNight.def: The story begins on a dark and stormy night.

LastDayOfNormalcy.name: Last Day of Normalcy
LastDayOfNormalcy.def: The audience is shown the heroes in their home setting before their normal lives are changed forever

LogicalLatecomer.name: Logical Latecomer
LogicalLatecomer.def: The new guy who points out the weirdness that everyone else ignores or is already used to.

LostInMediasRes.name: Lost in Medias Res
LostInMediasRes.def: A story that starts in the middle gets no elaboration for what came before it.

AMinorKidroduction.name: A Minor Kidroduction
AMinorKidroduction.def: A work begins with a brief scene of the protagonist as a child.

MinskyPickup.name: Minsky Pickup
MinskyPickup.def: The six note Intro Fanfare to a Song and Dance number.

MonsterMunch.name: Monster Munch
MonsterMunch.def: A monster is introduced by showing it killing a random, inconsequential victim.

MorningRoutine.name: Morning Routine
MorningRoutine.def: Introducing a character by showing what they do every morning.

MultipleGameOpenings.name: Multiple Game Openings
MultipleGameOpenings.def: The prologue changes depending on the player's choices before starting the game.

MythPrologue.name: Myth Prologue
MythPrologue.def: The work begins by telling a myth or other fantastical story that sets the basis for the plot.

NaiveNewcomer.name: Naïve Newcomer
NaiveNewcomer.def: A newcomer who is inexperienced and has trouble fitting in.

NonIndicativeFirstEpisode.name: Non-Indicative First Episode
NonIndicativeFirstEpisode.def: The first episode is not indicative of the rest of the series' tone.

OnceUponATime.name: Once Upon a Time
OnceUponATime.def: A stock phrase that opens classic stories.

OpenDoorOpening.name: Open-Door Opening
OpenDoorOpening.def: The story begins with a door opening and either the character or the audience passing through.

OpeningBossBattle.name: Opening Boss Battle
OpeningBossBattle.def: A Boss Battle that takes place early in the game.

OpeningMonologue.name: Opening Monologue
OpeningMonologue.def: The opening sequence has a monologue explaining the premise of the story.

OpeningNarration.name: Opening Narration
OpeningNarration.def: The opening sequence has a voice-over explaining the premise of the story.

OpeningSceneMurder.name: Opening Scene Murder
OpeningSceneMurder.def: Someone is murdered in the very first scene.

OpeningScroll.name: Opening Scroll
OpeningScroll.def: The opening sequence has text scroll that passes over the screen supplying information on the story.

OutOfJobIntoThePlot.name: Out of Job, Into the Plot
OutOfJobIntoThePlot.def: The protagonist loses their job shortly before or after the action begins.

PanFromTheSkyBeginning.name: "Pan from the Sky" Beginning
PanFromTheSkyBeginning.def: The view pans down from the sky to start off a movie or an episode.

Pilot.name: Pilot
Pilot.def: An experimental "first episode" of sorts that may or may not be picked up for production of a full-fledged television series.

PilotMovie.name: Pilot Movie
PilotMovie.def: A feature-length film that is intended to serve as the beginning of a television series.

PreMeeting.name: Pre-Meeting
PreMeeting.def: The main character meets a random person who turns out to be someone important.

Prequel.name: Prequel
Prequel.def: A continuation of a series that takes place before the events of the first installment and is therefore the chronological starting point of the series.

ProlongedPrologue.name: Prolonged Prologue
ProlongedPrologue.def: When the prologue of a story takes a long time to tell.

PursuedProtagonist.name: Pursued Protagonist
PursuedProtagonist.def: When a work opens with someone being chased.

PuttingTheBandTogether.name: Putting the Band Together
PuttingTheBandTogether.def: A work takes time to show the various members of a group being united.

QueerEstablishingMoment.name: Queer Establishing Moment
QueerEstablishingMoment.def: The moment after a character's introduction where the character is clarified to be LGBTQ+.

RaisedByConquerors.name: Raised by Conquerors
RaisedByConquerors.def: When a character's backstory has their town being razed by a conquering army, however the character is spared and taken adoptive by a father figure from the conquering party in order to be raised as a member of said conquering party.

RecruitTeenagersWithAttitude.name: Recruit Teenagers with Attitude
RecruitTeenagersWithAttitude.def: Instead of trained adults, teenagers save the day.

ResurrectedForAJob.name: Resurrected for a Job
ResurrectedForAJob.def: A person is brought Back from the Dead to go on a quest .

RRatedOpening.name: R-Rated Opening
RRatedOpening.def: The opening sequence contains mature content, letting audiences know what they're seeing is not for kids .

RunningOverThePlot.name: Running Over the Plot
RunningOverThePlot.def: The plot begins with running someone over or someone being ran over.

ScreamingCutToTheBreak.name: Screaming Cut to the Break
ScreamingCutToTheBreak.def: The prologue of a film or episode ends with a scream before we cut to the opening titles.

SecondEpisodeIntroduction.name: Second Episode Introduction
SecondEpisodeIntroduction.def: A prominent character in the series who takes until the second episode or installment to be introduced.

SecondEpisodeMorning.name: Second Episode Morning
SecondEpisodeMorning.def: A character has to deal with the strange events that happened in the first episode.

SecondEpisodeSubstitute.name: Second Episode Substitute
SecondEpisodeSubstitute.def: The second episode introduces a character who serves as a replacement for a character introduced in the first episode who is now absent.

ShipwreckStart.name: Shipwreck Start
ShipwreckStart.def: Protagonist is shipwrecked to start the story.

StartsWithASuicide.name: Starts with a Suicide
StartsWithASuicide.def: The story begins with someone committing or attempting to commit suicide.

StartsWithTheirFuneral.name: Starts with Their Funeral
StartsWithTheirFuneral.def: The story begins with a funeral before explaining how the person died.

StartToCorpse.name: Start to Corpse
StartToCorpse.def: The story begins with a dead body being discovered or someone being killed.

StarterVillain.name: Starter Villain
StarterVillain.def: The first villain the hero fights, usually only relevant in serving as the first threat the hero successfully thwarts.

StarterVillainStays.name: Starter Villain Stays
StarterVillainStays.def: The hero's first villain subsequently sticks around and continues to be a prominent enemy.

StepOneEscape.name: Step One: Escape
StepOneEscape.def: The initial goal is getting out of a room.

StorybookOpening.name: Storybook Opening
StorybookOpening.def: The story begins with a storybook opening.

SugarApocalypse.name: Sugar Apocalypse
SugarApocalypse.def: When a genuine Sugar Bowl suffers a horrifying disaster that destroys its peaceful innocence.

SurvivedTheBeginning.name: Survived the Beginning
SurvivedTheBeginning.def: A cast massacre opens the story, those who survive get some Plot Armor .

TheTeaser.name: The Teaser
TheTeaser.def: A scene that plays before the opening credits.

VillainOpeningScene.name: Villain Opening Scene
VillainOpeningScene.def: The antagonist is introduced before the other main characters are.

WarWasBeginning.name: War Was Beginning
WarWasBeginning.def: The story begins with a war starting.

WeatherReportOpening.name: Weather Report Opening
WeatherReportOpening.def: The first words in the story are about the weather.

WelcomeEpisode.name: Welcome Episode
WelcomeEpisode.def: The first episode begins with one of the main characters meeting the rest of the cast for the first time and being given information that is also beneficial for the audience.

WhenItAllBegan.name: When It All Began
WhenItAllBegan.def: The one moment or event that caused everything else in the story to be the way it is.

WhereIWasBornAndRazed.name: Where I Was Born and Razed
WhereIWasBornAndRazed.def: A character destroys their own hometown.

YouAllMeetInACell.name: You All Meet in a Cell
YouAllMeetInACell.def: Characters meet while they're all captive, and learn why they were taken captive in the first place while they escape.

YouAllMeetInAnInn.name: You All Meet in an Inn
YouAllMeetInAnInn.def: Everyone meets when they're at the same inn.

TheCallHasBadReception.name: The Call Has Bad Reception
TheCallHasBadReception.def: The Chosen One can't do their mission properly because they don't have the whole picture.

TheCallKnowsWhereYouLive.name: The Call Knows Where You Live
TheCallKnowsWhereYouLive.def: If you refuse to go on this adventure, the adventure will burn your house down and make you go on it.

TheCallLeftAMessage.name: The Call Left a Message
TheCallLeftAMessage.def: Only the Chosen One is allowed to hear this message.

TheCallPutMeOnHold.name: The Call Put Me on Hold
TheCallPutMeOnHold.def: The Chosen One is the only Muggle among superhumans .

CallReceptionArea.name: Call Reception Area
CallReceptionArea.def: Unless you want to go on an adventure, don't go here.

CantRefuseTheCallAnymore.name: Can't Refuse the Call Anymore
CantRefuseTheCallAnymore.def: The Chosen One can no longer ignore their destiny.

TheChooserOfTheOne.name: The Chooser of the One
TheChooserOfTheOne.def: The one that decides who The Chosen One is.

ConsequenceCombo.name: Consequence Combo
ConsequenceCombo.def: The Call comes. If the Chosen One says "yes", they get a prize. If they say "no", something horrible will happen.

DesperatelyLookingForAPurposeInLife.name: Desperately Looking for a Purpose in Life
DesperatelyLookingForAPurposeInLife.def: The Chosen One is desperate for a cause to fight for.

GotTheCallOnSpeedDial.name: Got the Call on Speed Dial
GotTheCallOnSpeedDial.def: The Chosen One had already finished their mission and is now looking for a new one.

HerosFirstRescue.name: Hero's First Rescue
HerosFirstRescue.def: You saved this guy? You just heeded the call.

ImDyingPleaseTakeMyMacGuffin.name: I'm Dying, Please Take My MacGuffin
ImDyingPleaseTakeMyMacGuffin.def: The call starts when a dying person gives you a Plot Device .

IgnorantOfTheCall.name: Ignorant of the Call
IgnorantOfTheCall.def: Everyone knows that the Chosen One is The Hero except of the Chosen One.

JumpedAtTheCall.name: Jumped at the Call
JumpedAtTheCall.def: The Chosen One gets the call and can't wait to heed it.

KidnappedByTheCall.name: Kidnapped by the Call
KidnappedByTheCall.def: The Call gives the Chosen One no choice in heeding it.

MissedTheCall.name: Missed the Call
MissedTheCall.def: The Chosen One missed their opportunity for the adventure.

RedPillBluePill.name: Red Pill, Blue Pill
RedPillBluePill.def: You have two choices: heed the call, or continue living like a regular person.

RefusalOfTheCall.name: Refusal of the Call
RefusalOfTheCall.def: The Chosen One willfully refuses to heed the call. Got Volunteered : A person is forced to join against their will.

WeAreNotGoingThroughThatAgain.name: We Are Not Going Through That Again
WeAreNotGoingThroughThatAgain.def: The Chosen One heeded one calling and refuses to heed another.

RefusedByTheCall.name: Refused by the Call
RefusedByTheCall.def: You want The Call, the Call doesn't want you.

RegularCaller.name: Regular Caller
RegularCaller.def: The Chosen One heeds many calls.

ResignedToTheCall.name: Resigned to the Call
ResignedToTheCall.def: The Chosen One heeds the call reluctantly.

RightManInTheWrongPlace.name: Right Man in the Wrong Place
RightManInTheWrongPlace.def: Some guy is asked to heed the call. Not because it's their call to heed, but because they really need a Chosen One right now.

ScreeningTheCall.name: Screening the Call
ScreeningTheCall.def: The Chosen One misses the call due to a character's meddling.

SymbolicHeroRebirth.name: Symbolic Hero Rebirth
SymbolicHeroRebirth.def: Death and rebirth symbolism accompany plotlines of hero who can no longer ignore their destiny.

TakeUpMySword.name: Take Up My Sword
TakeUpMySword.def: The Chosen One dies, so someone else needs to heed his call.

TwoRoadsBeforeYou.name: Two Roads Before You
TwoRoadsBeforeYou.def: Being presented with a choice between two or more mutually exclusive options.

EleventhHourCostumeChange.name: 11th-Hour Costume Change
EleventhHourCostumeChange.def: A character prepares for the big climactic battle by changing their outfit.

BigDamnHeroes.name: Big Damn Heroes
BigDamnHeroes.def: The heroes pull off a dramatic rescue.

ClimacticMaiming.name: Climactic Maiming
ClimacticMaiming.def: A character suffers a major injury or disfigurement during the climax of the story.

DeusExMachina.name: Deus ex Machina
DeusExMachina.def: An event from out of nowhere causes things to shift to the hero's favor.

DisneyDeath.name: Disney Death
DisneyDeath.def: A character who appeared to die at first subsequently turns out to still be alive or is miraculously resurrected.

DisneyVillainDeath.name: Disney Villain Death
DisneyVillainDeath.def: The villain ends up falling to their death.

EngineeredPublicConfession.name: Engineered Public Confession
EngineeredPublicConfession.def: A villain who has been able to hide their true nature from the public is tricked by the heroes into publicly admitting that they are a horrible person who was deceiving everyone.

EurekaMoment.name: "Eureka!" Moment
EurekaMoment.def: A character's thoughts or observations inspire them to come up with a plan.

FinalBoss.name: Final Boss
FinalBoss.def: The video game ends with one last boss fight that the player must win to finish the game. The final boss will almost always be the main antagonist.

FullPartySequence.name: Full-Party Sequence
FullPartySequence.def: While not exclusive to climaxes, they most often tend to happen there.

MainCharacterFinalBoss.name: Main Character Final Boss
MainCharacterFinalBoss.def: The game ends with the main character becoming the final boss, requiring their party to either fight to free them or kill them.

NecroCam.name: Necro Cam
NecroCam.def: A Flashback-Montage Realization solving the mystery of how a character died.

NoTimeToThink.name: No Time to Think
NoTimeToThink.def: A rushed, instinctual decision due to a lack of time.

TheReveal.name: The Reveal
TheReveal.def: A twist that involves a secret being revealed.

ThroneRoomThrowdown.name: Throne Room Throwdown
ThroneRoomThrowdown.def: a climatic fight scene occurs in a throne room.

SpeakNowOrForeverHoldYourPeace.name: Speak Now or Forever Hold Your Peace

ThirdActStupidity.name: Third Act Stupidity
ThirdActStupidity.def: The heroes or villains (or both) start acting stupid to sustain conflict in the climax.

VersionExclusiveFinalBoss.name: Version-Exclusive Final Boss
VersionExclusiveFinalBoss.def: Either an altered or a new iteration of the final boss pops out in another version of the game.

WeddingSmashers.name: Wedding Smashers
WeddingSmashers.def: A rush to stop a wedding.

WhoNeedsOvertime.name: Who Needs Overtime?
WhoNeedsOvertime.def: In fiction, climactic sports games never go into overtime.

HundredPercentCompletion.name: 100% Completion
HundredPercentCompletion.def: When collecting everything there is to collect in a video game and achieving all the game's side quests and objectives is the only way to see the canon ending.

AccidentalDownerEnding.name: Accidental Downer Ending
AccidentalDownerEnding.def: A work ends on a down note with hints and promises that it will be continued, but it does not.

AdaptationalAlternateEnding.name: Adaptational Alternate Ending
AdaptationalAlternateEnding.def: An adaptation changes how the story ends.

AfterAdventureRestoration.name: After-Adventure Restoration
AfterAdventureRestoration.def: A person is restored, as much as possible, to how they were before they went on an adventure.

AlbumClosure.name: Album Closure
AlbumClosure.def: The final song on an album wraps up its tone/themes.

AlignmentBasedEndings.name: Alignment-Based Endings
AlignmentBasedEndings.def: The video game's ending depends on your moral alignment.

AllegedlyOptimisticEnding.name: Allegedly Optimistic Ending
AllegedlyOptimisticEnding.def: The ending is supposed to be happy or bittersweet, but the audience thinks it's a Downer Ending .

AllIsWellThatEndsWell.name: All Is Well That Ends Well
AllIsWellThatEndsWell.def: A character goes through a lot of hardship and strife, but once they get their happy ending they appear completely unaffected by this.

AllJustADream.name: All Just a Dream
AllJustADream.def: It turns out the whole story was just a dream the protagonist was having.

AllJustAPrank.name: All Just a Prank
AllJustAPrank.def: A major plot ends up to be a practical joke.

AllThereInTheStinger.name: All There in the Stinger
AllThereInTheStinger.def: When The Stinger provides information that is necessary to understanding the overall plot.

AmbiguousCloneEnding.name: Ambiguous Clone Ending
AmbiguousCloneEnding.def: It's left ambiguous whether a person is the real deal or a copied replacement.

AmbiguousEnding.name: Ambiguous Ending
AmbiguousEnding.def: The ending is left open to the viewer's interpretation.

AndTheAdventureContinues.name: And the Adventure Continues
AndTheAdventureContinues.def: The story ends with the heroes preparing for another adventure.

AndYourRewardIsInfancy.name: And Your Reward Is Infancy
AndYourRewardIsInfancy.def: The story ends with the main character becoming a baby.

AntiClimax.name: Anti-Climax
AntiClimax.def: Suspense is killed when it would normally be at its highest.

ApocalypseWow.name: Apocalypse Wow
ApocalypseWow.def: The apocalypse is absolutely nightmarish, but man if it isn't cool!

AudienceAlienatingEnding.name: Audience-Alienating Ending
AudienceAlienatingEnding.def: Audiences dislike the ending of a work they otherwise enjoy.

AwakeningAtTheEnd.name: Awakening at the End
AwakeningAtTheEnd.def: A story set in some kind of dream or illusion ends with the character(s) returning to the real world.

AwesomeMomentOfCrowning.name: Awesome Moment of Crowning
AwesomeMomentOfCrowning.def: Story ends with character being crowned ruler of the land they just saved.

BabiesEverAfter.name: Babies Ever After
BabiesEverAfter.def: The story ends with the heroes having children.

BackForTheFinale.name: Back for the Finale
BackForTheFinale.def: A character who hasn't been seen in a while returns at the end of the series.

TheBadGuyWins.name: The Bad Guy Wins
TheBadGuyWins.def: The villain succeeds in their plan and gets what they want.

BecomingTheGenie.name: Becoming the Genie
BecomingTheGenie.def: Someone gets turned into a wish-granting entity.

BelatedHappyEnding.name: Belated Happy Ending
BelatedHappyEnding.def: A story with an Ambiguous Ending is given a happy ending in the sequel.

BigFinaleCrowdSong.name: Big Finale Crowd Song
BigFinaleCrowdSong.def: A musical ends with a large Crowd Song to tie things up.

BigRockEnding.name: Big Rock Ending
BigRockEnding.def: The Grand Finale of a song is spent with the musicians hammering away on their instruments.

Bittersweet17.name: Bittersweet 17
Bittersweet17.def: A 17-year-old who is in their coming-of-age.

BittersweetEnding.name: Bittersweet Ending
BittersweetEnding.def: The story's ending is both happy and sad.

BluffingTheMurderer.name: Bluffing the Murderer
BluffingTheMurderer.def: Somebody is pretty sure who dunnit, but doesn't know for sure so tries to trick the suspect into confessing.

BolivianArmyCliffhanger.name: Bolivian Army Cliffhanger
BolivianArmyCliffhanger.def: A show's season ends on a cliffhanger where it's hard to tell who survived and who didn't.

BolivianArmyEnding.name: Bolivian Army Ending
BolivianArmyEnding.def: The work ends on a cliffhanger, with the characters facing Uncertain Doom .

BonusMaterial.name: Bonus Material
BonusMaterial.def: Extra goods that is added to, but separate from, a particular work.

BoringReturnJourney.name: Boring Return Journey
BoringReturnJourney.def: The trip back home pales in comparison to the adventure it took to get to the destination.

BrickJoke.name: Brick Joke
BrickJoke.def: A joke that was set up and forgotten about finally gets a punchline.

ButNowIMustGo.name: But Now I Must Go
ButNowIMustGo.def: A work or installment of a work ends with a character who helped having to leave for no other reason than "it's the way things need to go".

CallToAgriculture.name: Call to Agriculture
CallToAgriculture.def: A badass/heroic character retires as a farmer.

CantStopTheSignal.name: Can't Stop the Signal
CantStopTheSignal.def: The discoverers of a hidden secret, attempt to ensure it's spread far and wide.

TheCavalryArrivesLate.name: The Cavalry Arrives Late
TheCavalryArrivesLate.def: The hero has reinforcements, but they don't show up until after the day is saved.

ChampionsOnTheInside.name: Champions on the Inside
ChampionsOnTheInside.def: The characters lose the championship, but still feel like winners on the inside.

ChasedOffIntoTheSunset.name: Chased Off into the Sunset
ChasedOffIntoTheSunset.def: The story ends with a character being chased by another character towards the sunset.

ChristmasEpilogue.name: Christmas Epilogue
ChristmasEpilogue.def: The story ends at Christmas / there's a Time Skip to Christmas.

CircularCharacterArc.name: Circular Character Arc
CircularCharacterArc.def: A character underwent development , but by the end has a similar personality to when they were introduced.

CliffHanger.name: Cliffhanger
CliffHanger.def: Ending an episode/chapter/season/etc with one or more characters in danger (the ambiguity is that it's unknown at the time how/if they'll get out of danger).

CliffhangerCopout.name: Cliffhanger Copout
CliffhangerCopout.def: A series has one episode end on a clear cliffhanger and never explains the outcome of that cliffhanger.

CompletionMockery.name: Completion Mockery
CompletionMockery.def: The game mocks the player after they done for it or having the 100% Completion .

ConclusionInAnotherMedium.name: Conclusion in Another Medium
ConclusionInAnotherMedium.def: A series that was Cut Short is given a proper conclusion outside of its original media.

ConclusiveConfession.name: Conclusive Confession
ConclusiveConfession.def: A culprit is confronted with evidence of something they did, in turn pushing them to confess and try to justify their actions or provide motives.

CosmicDeadline.name: Cosmic Deadline
CosmicDeadline.def: The rate the plot resolves itself starts going into overdrive near the end of the story due to development problems.

CosmicHorrorReveal.name: Cosmic Horror Reveal
CosmicHorrorReveal.def: A story ends with revealing it's actually a Cosmic Horror Story .

CrossoverFinale.name: Crossover Finale
CrossoverFinale.def: Characters from a Spin-Off and/or other parts of a Shared Universe return for a work's grand finale.

CruelTwistEnding.name: Cruel Twist Ending
CruelTwistEnding.def: A twist ending that serves no purpose other than to be exclusively cruel .

CurtainCall.name: Curtain Call
CurtainCall.def: The whole cast comes out at the end of the story.

CutShort.name: Cut Short
CutShort.def: A series ends without a proper conclusion to the story.

DancePartyEnding.name: Dance Party Ending
DancePartyEnding.def: The story ends with everyone dancing.

DancingMookCredits.name: Dancing Mook Credits
DancingMookCredits.def: The end credits of a video game show animations of the game's enemies.

DarkenedBuildingShootout.name: Darkened Building Shootout
DarkenedBuildingShootout.def: A classic denouement — the hero and villain have a shootout in a darkened building, with a suitably suspenseful final shot.

DawnOfAnEra.name: Dawn of an Era
DawnOfAnEra.def: The story ends with the start of a new era.

DeadlyDistantFinale.name: Deadly Distant Finale
DeadlyDistantFinale.def: The story ends with a flash forward to a character's later years where they die.

DeathOfTheHypotenuse.name: Death of the Hypotenuse
DeathOfTheHypotenuse.def: The third person in a Love Triangle passes away, thus solving the issue in question for the other two characters.

DefeatByTransformation.name: Defeat by Transformation
DefeatByTransformation.def: In the end, the villain can only be defeated by being transformed.

DefeatMeansMenialLabor.name: Defeat Means Menial Labor
DefeatMeansMenialLabor.def: Where the villain, upon defeat, is reduced to performing menial labor.

DemorphingDenouement.name: Demorphing Denouement
DemorphingDenouement.def: The story's climax or ending features a transformed character being restored to their original form.

Denouement.name: Dénouement
Denouement.def: The story ends with loose ends being tied up after The Climax .

DenouementEpisode.name: Dénouement Episode
DenouementEpisode.def: The final episode is an epilogue to the Grand Finale .

DestroyTheEvidence.name: Destroy the Evidence
